ja.R: 天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、わたしたちのうちの少しの者を生かしておいてくださった。 \q もしそうでなかったら、わたしたちはソドムの町のように、すっかり滅ぼされていただろう。 \q ゴモラの町のように、滅ぼされていただろう。

decisions.choice: Yahweh of hosts: Yahweh, commander of all the armies of heaven and earth
decisions.reason: Tseba'ot is the plural of a word for an army or a host, a great company drawn up in ranks. It is used of Israel's armies (Exodus 12:41; 1 Samuel 17:45), of the stars (Isaiah 40:26) and of the heavenly beings around God's throne (1 Kings 22:19; Psalm 103:21). Joined to God's name, it presents Yahweh as the King who commands every power in heaven and on earth: Isaiah sees him enthroned as "the King, Yahweh of hosts" (6:5). It is one of Isaiah's favorite names for God, used about sixty times in the book, and this is the first. The Septuagint of Isaiah keeps the Hebrew word, "Lord Sabaoth", and Romans 9:29 quotes this verse in that form.

decisions.choice: Sodom and Gomorrah: cities destroyed completely
decisions.reason: God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah with fire, leaving no one but Lot's family (Genesis 19:24-29). Without God's mercy Judah would have been wiped out as completely. Paul quotes the verse in Romans 9:29, where the Greek has "offspring" for "survivors".

decisions.choice: a few: going with "survivors" (a small remnant)
alternatives: we would almost have been like Sodom
decisions.reason: The word for "a little" may describe the survivors (a few of them) or go with what follows ("we would almost have been like Sodom"). The Hebrew accents join it to "survivors".

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies
decisions.reason: "Hosts" was once the ordinary word for an army, but today it most often means someone who welcomes guests, so it hides what the title says. Balanced and Readable say "Armies" here and throughout Isaiah: it states the meaning plainly and keeps the picture of a commander. "Almighty" was considered, but it turns the picture into an abstract quality. Literal keeps the traditional "the LORD of hosts".

decisions.choice: wiped out ... destroyed
decisions.reason: Readable says what it meant to be like Sodom and Gomorrah: to be destroyed.

decisions.choice: el SEÑOR de los ejércitos (L); el SEÑOR de los Ejércitos (B, R)
decisions.reason: Spanish "ejércitos" already says what the English B and R make plain with "Armies", so every level keeps the word; B and R capitalize it as a title, as the Samuel note and Psalms 24:10 and 46:8 do. Book-wide choice, recorded once for chapters 1-20.

decisions.choice: "BWANA wa majeshi" at every level
decisions.reason: The Swahili title of Samuel and the Psalms is kept at every level; Swahili "majeshi" already covers armies of heaven and earth (m1), so it needs no change at B and R where the English moves to "Armies".

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR des armées"
decisions.reason: French keeps "des armées" at every level, as Samuel, the Psalms and 2 Kings 19:31: unlike English "hosts", "armées" still says army plainly, so no change is needed at Balanced and Readable. For the whole book.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA Vạn Quân", with the span on "CHÚA" only
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for "the LORD of hosts" through the book (2 Kings 19:31; Samuel; Psalms); "Vạn Quân" covers both the armies of heaven and Israel's, as the meaning decision reads it.

decisions.choice: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (L, B); "하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for *YHWH tseba'ot*. "만군" is the familiar Korean word for the hosts and keeps the picture of armies; Readable spells it out. In God's own mouth Readable says "거느린".

decisions.choice: o SENHOR dos Exércitos (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book, where the title first appears (m1): "o SENHOR dos Exércitos" at every level, as 1 Samuel 1:3 and the Psalms have it in Portuguese. Portuguese "Exércitos" says plainly what the plural tseba'ot means and has none of the misleading sense of English "hosts", so all three levels can use it. "O Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos" follows from it (1:24).

decisions.choice: sobreviventes (L); alguns de nós sobrevivessem / alguns de nós com vida (B, R)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the verse in Romans 9:29 from the Greek, which has "offspring" ("uma semente" at Literal, "alguns descendentes" in Romans' Portuguese). Isaiah follows the Hebrew, which says "survivors" (m2), so the word differs; the rest keeps Romans' Portuguese where the Hebrew allows: "o Senhor dos Exércitos", "como Sodoma", "Gomorra".

decisions.choice: YHWH Tsevaot: "[[-]] ጸባኦት" (L), "የሠራዊት አምላክ [[-]]" (B, R), for the whole book
alternatives: "ጌታ ጸባኦት" as in Romans 9:29 (the Greek's kyrios, not the divine name)
decisions.reason: The title recurs some sixty times in Isaiah; Literal keeps the Hebrew word as the name of the God of the armies of heaven, as Romans 9:29 keeps it ("ጌታ ጸባኦት"), and Balanced and Readable say what it means, as in Kings and the Psalms. Paul quotes this verse from the Greek, which has "Lord" for the divine name and "seed" ("ዘር") for the survivors; the Hebrew says "survivors", so the Amharic follows the Hebrew there and keeps Romans' "እንደ ሰዶም በሆንን ነበር፤ ገሞራንም በመሰልን ነበር" where the two agree.

decisions.choice: सेनाओं के {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}
decisions.reason: "YHWH of hosts" is सेनाओं के प्रभु at every level, as Romans 9:29 (Balanced) and the history note have it. The English Balanced and Readable say "of Armies"; सेनाओं already means armies, so one form serves all three levels. Book-wide choice.

decisions.choice: हम सदोम के समान हो जाते, और अमोरा के तुल्य ठहरते (L); ... और अमोरा के जैसे बन जाते (B)
alternatives: यदि ... हमारे लिए वंश न छोड़ा होता
decisions.reason: Romans 9:29 quotes this verse. The second half keeps Romans' Hindi wording at each level. The first half follows the Hebrew "survivors, a few" (बचे हुए), not Romans' "seed" (वंश), which comes from the Greek Old Testament.

decisions.choice: "ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф" (L, B); "ГОСПОДЬ Воинств" (R)
decisions.reason: The title is settled for the whole Old Testament: Саваоф, the traditional transcription Romans 9:29 uses when it quotes this verse, at Literal and Balanced; Воинств, which says what the title means, at Readable. Саваоф declines (Саваофа).

decisions.choice: the wording of Romans 9:29 where the Hebrew agrees ("мы стали бы как Содом... Гоморре", "стёрты с лица земли")
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this verse in Romans 9:29. The comparison with Sodom and Gomorrah keeps the wording of Romans at each level. Romans follows the Greek Old Testament's "seed" (семени, потомства); the Hebrew has "survivors", so Isaiah says "уцелевших" / "немногих из нас".

decisions.choice: YHWH tseva'ot: "万軍の{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}" (L, B), "天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}" (R), as 1-2 Samuel, Kings and Chronicles, and as Romans 9:29 (B, R), which quotes this verse.
decisions.reason: The title must read the same in the historical books and the prophets; Readable spells out what "万軍" means (m1), as the English Readable "of Armies" does.

decisions.choice: sarid "survivors": "生き残り" (L), "生き残らせる" (B), "生かしておく" (R); the remnant words she'ar / she'erit are "残りの者" (L, B), as Romans 9:27, and "生き残った人々" (R).
decisions.reason: sarid and she'ar are different Hebrew words; keeping "残りの者" for she'ar lets the reader follow Isaiah's remnant theme (Shear-jashub, 7:3; 10:20-22).

source.text: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה קְצִינֵ֣י סְדֹ֑ם הַאֲזִ֛ינוּ תּוֹרַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ עַ֥ם עֲמֹרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear [the] word of Yahweh, rulers of Sodom; give ear [to the] instruction of our God, people of Gomorrah.

en.L: Hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you rulers of Sodom; \q give ear to the instruction of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
en.B: Rulers of Sodom, hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q People of Gomorrah, open your ears to the instruction of our God!
en.R: You leaders are like the rulers of Sodom. Listen to the message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q You people are like the people of Gomorrah. Listen to what our God is teaching you!

es.L: {{plural_you:Oigan|Oíd}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, gobernantes de Sodoma; \q {{plural_you:presten|prestad}} oído a la instrucción de nuestro Dios, pueblo de Gomorra.
es.B: ¡Gobernantes de Sodoma, {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchad}} la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}! \q ¡Pueblo de Gomorra, {{plural_you:abran sus oídos|abrid vuestros oídos}} a la instrucción de nuestro Dios!
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes, los jefes, son|Vosotros, los jefes, sois}} como los gobernantes de Sodoma. ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} el mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}! \q {{plural_you:Ustedes, el pueblo, son|Vosotros, el pueblo, sois}} como la gente de Gomorra. ¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}} lo que nuestro Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} enseña!

fr.L: Écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, chefs de Sodome ; \q prêtez l’oreille à la loi de notre Dieu, peuple de Gomorrhe !
fr.B: Chefs de Sodome, écoutez la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! \q Peuple de Gomorrhe, tends l’oreille à l’instruction de notre Dieu !
fr.R: Vous, les chefs, vous êtes comme les dirigeants de Sodome. Écoutez le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! \q Vous, le peuple, vous êtes comme les gens de Gomorrhe. Écoutez l’enseignement de notre Dieu !

sw.L: Sikieni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi watawala wa Sodoma; \q tegeni sikio sheria ya Mungu wetu, enyi watu wa Gomora!
sw.B: Enyi watawala wa Sodoma, sikilizeni neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Enyi watu wa Gomora, tegeni masikio kwa mafundisho ya Mungu wetu!
sw.R: Enyi viongozi, mko kama watawala wa Sodoma. Sikilizeni ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Enyi watu, mko kama watu wa Gomora. Sikilizeni yale ambayo Mungu wetu anawafundisha!

vi.L: Hãy nghe lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi các người cai trị Sô-đôm; \q hãy lắng tai nghe lời dạy dỗ của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, hỡi dân Gô-mô-rơ!
vi.B: Hỡi những kẻ cai trị Sô-đôm, hãy nghe lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hỡi dân Gô-mô-rơ, hãy lắng tai nghe lời dạy dỗ của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta!
vi.R: Hỡi các nhà lãnh đạo, các người giống như những kẻ cai trị Sô-đôm. Hãy nghe điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán! \q Hỡi dân chúng, các người giống như dân Gô-mô-rơ. Hãy lắng nghe điều Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta đang dạy các người!

ko.L: 소돔의 통치자들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 들어라. \q 고모라의 백성아, 우리 하나님의 가르침에 귀를 기울여라.
ko.B: 소돔의 통치자들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 들어라. \q 고모라의 백성아, 우리 하나님의 가르침에 귀를 기울여라.
ko.R: 너희 지도자들은 소돔의 통치자들과 같다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀을 들어라! \q 너희 백성은 고모라 사람들과 같다. 우리 하나님께서 너희에게 가르치시는 것을 들어라!

pt.L: Ouçam a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, governantes de Sodoma; \q deem ouvidos à instrução do nosso Deus, povo de Gomorra!
pt.B: Governantes de Sodoma, ouçam a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}! \q Povo de Gomorra, prestem atenção à instrução do nosso Deus!
pt.R: Vocês, líderes, são como os governantes de Sodoma. Escutem a mensagem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}! \q Vocês, povo, são como o povo de Gomorra. Escutem o que o nosso Deus está ensinando a vocês!

am.L: እናንተ የሰዶም አለቆች፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃል ስሙ፤ \q እናንተ የገሞራ ሕዝብ፣ የአምላካችንን ትምህርት አድምጡ!
am.B: እናንተ የሰዶም ገዢዎች፣ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃል ስሙ! \q እናንተ የገሞራ ሕዝብ፣ የአምላካችንን ትምህርት በጆሯችሁ አድምጡ!
am.R: እናንተ መሪዎች እንደ ሰዶም ገዢዎች ናችሁ። {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} የመጣውን መልእክት ስሙ! \q እናንተ ሕዝብ እንደ ገሞራ ሕዝብ ናችሁ። አምላካችን የሚያስተምራችሁን አድምጡ!

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन सुनो, हे सदोम के शासको; \q हमारे परमेश्वर की शिक्षा पर कान लगाओ, हे अमोरा की प्रजा!
hi.B: हे सदोम के शासको, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन सुनो! \q हे अमोरा के लोगो, हमारे परमेश्वर की शिक्षा पर कान लगाओ!
hi.R: तुम अगुवे सदोम के शासकों के समान हो। {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का संदेश सुनो! \q तुम लोग अमोरा के लोगों के समान हो। सुनो कि हमारे परमेश्वर तुम्हें क्या सिखा रहे हैं!

ru.L: Слушайте слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, правители Содома; \q внимайте наставлению нашего Бога, народ Гоморры!
ru.B: Правители Содома, слушайте слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}! \q Народ Гоморры, прислушайтесь к наставлению нашего Бога!
ru.R: Вы, начальники, похожи на правителей Содома. Слушайте, что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}! \q Вы, люди, похожи на жителей Гоморры. Слушайте, чему учит вас наш Бог!

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉を聞け、ソドムの首領たちよ。 \q わたしたちの神の教えに耳を傾けよ、ゴモラの民よ！
ja.B: ソドムの指導者たちよ、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉を聞きなさい！ \q ゴモラの民よ、わたしたちの神の教えに耳を傾けなさい！
ja.R: あなたたち指導者は、ソドムの指導者たちのようだ。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉を聞きなさい！ \q あなたたち民は、ゴモラの人々のようだ。わたしたちの神が教えておられることを聞きなさい！

decisions.choice: rulers of Sodom, people of Gomorrah: Jerusalem's leaders and people, as wicked as those cities
decisions.reason: Verse 9 said Judah escaped Sodom's fate. Now its rulers and people are called by those names, because their deeds are like Sodom's (3:9; Ezekiel 16:46-50).

decisions.choice: instruction: teaching from God
decisions.reason: The word torah means instruction or teaching. Here it is the teaching God gives through the prophet in the verses that follow (compare 2:3; 8:16, 20).

decisions.choice: You leaders are like ... You people are like
decisions.reason: Readable explains that the names are a comparison: Jerusalem's leaders and people are not literally in Sodom and Gomorrah.

decisions.choice: la instrucción (L, B); enseña (R)
decisions.reason: Torah is "instrucción" at L and B and teaching at R, as the Psalms note sets it; "la ley" would narrow the prophet's teaching to the Law of Moses.

decisions.choice: "sheria" (L), "mafundisho" (B, R) for *torah*
decisions.reason: God's *torah* is "sheria" at Literal and "mafundisho" (teaching) at Balanced and Readable, the rule of the Psalms note followed through the Swahili prophets; the teaching sense of the prophet's message beside "the word of the LORD" (m2) is carried by the other levels.

decisions.choice: "la loi" (L), "l’instruction" (B), "l’enseignement" (R)
decisions.reason: God's *torah* is one word family in Isaiah and Jeremiah, as the French Psalms and the terms note set it: "loi" at Literal, "instruction" at Balanced (with the English "instruction"), "enseignement" at Readable, so the higher levels show it is teaching and not only a legal code.

decisions.choice: "Hãy nghe lời của CHÚA" (L); "hãy nghe lời CHÚA" (B); "Hãy nghe điều CHÚA phán" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for "hear the word of the LORD", as 2 Kings 20:16.

decisions.choice: "가르침" for *torah*
decisions.reason: As the Psalms note and the English "instruction": God's teaching through the prophet, not a legal code.

decisions.choice: Elohim "አምላክ" with a possessor ("አምላካችን", our God), "እግዚአብሔር" where it stands alone for the one God; instruction (torah) here "ትምህርት"
decisions.reason: The terms lists give El and Elohim as "እግዚአብሔር" and keep "አምላክ" for "my God, our God". Torah in the prophets is God's teaching given through the prophet, so "ትምህርት" is used rather than "ሕግ", as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: शिक्षा
decisions.reason: torah here is the teaching the prophet brings, parallel to "the word of the LORD", not the Law of Moses as a code; शिक्षा says that at every level, as the English "instruction" does.

decisions.choice: "наставление" for torah here
decisions.reason: Here torah stands parallel to "the word of the LORD" and means the prophet's teaching from God (the meaning decision), not the written Law of Moses, so it is "наставление" rather than the capitalised "Закон" used for the Law.

decisions.choice: shim'u devar YHWH "Hear the word of the LORD": "{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉を聞け" (L), "…の言葉を聞きなさい" (B, R); torah in the prophets "教え" at every level (not "律法").
alternatives: "主の言葉を聞け" at every level
decisions.reason: One form for the prophets' summons, following the command forms of 1:2. torah here is God's instruction through the prophet (m2), parallel to "the word", so "教え" as Proverbs and 2 Kings 22 Readable; "律法" would point to the law of Moses.

source.text: לָמָּה־לִּ֤י רֹב־זִבְחֵיכֶם֙ יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שָׂבַ֛עְתִּי עֹל֥וֹת אֵילִ֖ים וְחֵ֣לֶב מְרִיאִ֑ים וְדַ֨ם פָּרִ֧ים וּכְבָשִׂ֛ים וְעַתּוּדִ֖ים לֹ֥א חָפָֽצְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Why to me [the] multitude of your sacrifices? says Yahweh. I am sated [with] burnt offerings of rams and [the] fat of fatlings; and [the] blood of bulls and lambs and goats not I delight in.

en.L: What [is] the multitude of your sacrifices to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I have had enough of burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fattened animals, \q and in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats I take no delight.
en.B: What use to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} are all your sacrifices? says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I have had all I want of burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fattened beasts; \q the blood of bulls and lambs and goats gives {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} no pleasure.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says: Why do you bring {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} so many sacrifices? \q I have had all I want of the rams you burn on the altar and the fat of your fattened animals. \q I do not enjoy the blood of your bulls, lambs, and goats.

es.L: ¿Qué [es] para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} la multitud de {{plural_you:sus sacrificios|vuestros sacrificios}}?, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Harto estoy de holocaustos de carneros y de la grasa de animales cebados, \q y en la sangre de toros, de corderos y de machos cabríos no me complazco.
es.B: ¿De qué {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sirven todos {{plural_you:sus sacrificios|vuestros sacrificios}}?, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Ya estoy harto de holocaustos de carneros y de la grasa de animales engordados; \q la sangre de toros, de corderos y de machos cabríos no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} agrada.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice: ¿Por qué {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:traen|traéis}} tantos sacrificios? \q Ya tengo más que suficiente de los carneros que {{plural_you:queman|quemáis}} sobre el altar y de la grasa de {{plural_you:sus animales|vuestros animales}} engordados. \q No disfruto de la sangre de {{plural_you:sus toros|vuestros toros}}, corderos y cabras.

fr.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}[importe] la multitude de vos sacrifices ? dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Je suis rassasié d’holocaustes de béliers et de la graisse des bêtes engraissées, \q et le sang des taureaux, des agneaux et des boucs, je n’y prends pas plaisir.
fr.B: À quoi {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servent tous vos sacrifices ? dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q J’en ai assez des holocaustes de béliers et de la graisse des bêtes engraissées ; \q le sang des taureaux, des agneaux et des boucs ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} plaît pas.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : Pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}apportez-vous tant de sacrifices ? \q J’en ai assez des béliers que vous brûlez sur l’autel et de la graisse de vos bêtes engraissées. \q Le sang de vos taureaux, de vos agneaux et de vos boucs ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} fait pas plaisir.

sw.L: Wingi wa dhabihu zenu [ni nini] kwangu? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Nimeshiba sadaka za kuteketezwa za kondoo dume na mafuta ya wanyama walionona, \q wala sipendezwi na damu ya mafahali na wana-kondoo na mbuzi.
sw.B: Dhabihu zenu zote zina faida gani {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Nimeshiba sadaka za kuteketezwa za kondoo dume na mafuta ya wanyama walionenepeshwa; \q damu ya mafahali, ya wana-kondoo na ya mbuzi hainipendezi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema: Kwa nini mnaniletea dhabihu nyingi hivi? \q Nimechoshwa na kondoo dume mnaowateketeza madhabahuni na mafuta ya wanyama wenu walionona. \q Sifurahii damu ya mafahali wenu, wana-kondoo na mbuzi.

vi.L: Muôn vàn sinh tế của các ngươi [có ích gì] cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. \q Ta đã chán ngấy tế lễ thiêu bằng chiên đực và mỡ của thú béo, \q và huyết của bò đực, chiên con và dê đực, Ta chẳng ưa thích.
vi.B: Vô số sinh tế của các ngươi có ích gì cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. \q Ta đã quá đủ tế lễ thiêu bằng chiên đực và mỡ của thú vật vỗ béo; \q huyết của bò đực, chiên con và dê đực chẳng làm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vui lòng.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Sao các ngươi đem đến cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nhiều sinh tế như vậy? \q Ta đã quá đủ những con chiên đực các ngươi thiêu trên bàn thờ và mỡ của thú vật các ngươi vỗ béo. \q Ta không ưa thích huyết của bò đực, chiên con và dê đực của các ngươi.

ko.L: 너희의 많은 제물이 나에게 무엇이냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 나는 숫양의 번제물과 살진 짐승의 기름에 질렸고, \q 수소와 어린양과 숫염소의 피를 나는 기뻐하지 않는다.
ko.B: 너희가 바치는 그 많은 제물이 나에게 무슨 소용이냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 나는 숫양의 번제물과 살진 짐승의 기름이라면 이제 넌더리가 난다. \q 수소와 어린양과 숫염소의 피도 나는 반갑지 않다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 너희는 왜 나에게 그렇게 많은 제물을 가져오느냐? \q 너희가 제단에서 태워 바치는 숫양과 살진 짐승의 기름은 이제 지겹다. \q 나는 너희 수소와 어린양과 염소의 피가 기쁘지 않다.

pt.L: De que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} [serve] a multidão dos sacrifícios de vocês? diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Estou saciado de holocaustos de carneiros e de gordura de animais de engorda, \q e no sangue de touros, cordeiros e bodes não tenho prazer.
pt.B: De que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servem todos esses sacrifícios de vocês? diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Já recebi holocaustos de carneiros e gordura de animais de engorda mais do que o suficiente; \q o sangue de touros, cordeiros e bodes não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dá prazer nenhum.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Por que vocês {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} trazem tantos sacrifícios? \q Já recebi mais do que o suficiente de carneiros queimados no altar e da gordura dos seus animais de engorda. \q Não tenho prazer no sangue dos seus touros, cordeiros e bodes.

am.L: የመሥዋዕቶቻችሁ ብዛት ለእኔ ምን [ይጠቅማል]? ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q የአውራ በጎች የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና የሰቡ እንስሳት ስብ ጠግቤአለሁ፤ \q በኮርማዎችና በጠቦቶች፣ በአውራ ፍየሎችም ደም ደስ አይለኝም።
am.B: የመሥዋዕቶቻችሁ ብዛት ለእኔ ምን ይጠቅመኛል? ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q የአውራ በጎችን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና የሰቡ እንስሳትን ስብ እስኪበቃኝ ድረስ ጠግቤአለሁ፤ \q የኮርማዎችና የጠቦቶች፣ የአውራ ፍየሎችም ደም ደስ አያሰኘኝም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ይህን ሁሉ መሥዋዕት ለምን ታመጡልኛላችሁ? \q በመሠዊያው ላይ የምታቃጥሏቸውን አውራ በጎችና የሰቡ እንስሶቻችሁን ስብ ጠግቤአለሁ። \q የኮርማዎቻችሁ፣ የጠቦቶቻችሁና የፍየሎቻችሁ ደም ደስ አያሰኘኝም።

hi.L: तुम्हारे बलिदानों की बहुतायत मेरे लिए क्या [है]? {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। \q मैं मेढ़ों के होमबलियों और पाले हुए पशुओं की चर्बी से तृप्त हो चुका हूँ, \q और बैलों और मेमनों और बकरों के लहू से मैं प्रसन्न नहीं होता।
hi.B: तुम्हारे ढेर सारे बलिदान मेरे किस काम के? {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। \q मेढ़ों के होमबलियों और मोटे-ताज़े पशुओं की चर्बी से मेरा जी भर गया है; \q बैलों, मेमनों और बकरों का लहू मुझे कोई आनंद नहीं देता।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं: तुम मेरे पास इतने सारे बलिदान क्यों लाते हो? \q वेदी पर जलाए जानेवाले तुम्हारे मेढ़ों और तुम्हारे मोटे किए हुए पशुओं की चर्बी से मेरा जी भर गया है। \q तुम्हारे बैलों, मेमनों और बकरों के लहू से मुझे कोई ख़ुशी नहीं होती।

ru.L: Зачем {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} множество ваших жертв? — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q Я пресыщен всесожжениями баранов и жиром откормленного скота, \q и крови быков, и ягнят, и козлов не желаю.
ru.B: Какая {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} польза от всех ваших жертв? — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q Я сыт всесожжениями баранов и жиром откормленных животных; \q кровь быков, ягнят и козлов {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} не в радость.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} говорит: Зачем вы приносите {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} столько жертв? \q Я сыт баранами, которых вы сжигаете на жертвеннике, и жиром ваших откормленных животных. \q Меня не радует кровь ваших быков, ягнят и козлов.

ja.L: あなたがたのおびただしいいけにえは、わたしにとって何になるのか？と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q わたしは雄羊の焼き尽くすささげ物と、肥えた家畜の脂肪に飽きた。 \q 雄牛や小羊や雄やぎの血を、わたしは喜ばない。
ja.B: あなたがたの数多くのいけにえが、わたしに何の役に立つのか？と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q 雄羊の焼き尽くすささげ物も、肥えた獣の脂肪も、わたしはもうたくさんだ。 \q 雄牛や小羊や雄やぎの血も、わたしは喜ばない。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言う。なぜ、こんなに多くのいけにえをわたしのところに持って来るのか？ \q 祭壇で焼いてささげる雄羊も、太らせた家畜の脂肪も、もうたくさんだ。 \q 雄牛や小羊ややぎの血も、わたしはうれしくない。

decisions.choice: burnt offerings, fat, blood: the parts of a sacrifice given to God
decisions.reason: A burnt offering was burned whole on the altar (Leviticus 1). In other sacrifices the fat was burned for God and the blood poured out at the altar, since both belonged to him (Leviticus 3:16-17).

decisions.choice: I take no delight: God rejects worship offered by people who do injustice
decisions.reason: God had commanded these sacrifices. What he rejects is worship from hands full of blood (verse 15), offered by people who neglect justice (verses 16-17). Other prophets say the same (1 Samuel 15:22; Hosea 6:6; Amos 5:21-24; Micah 6:6-8).

decisions.choice: The LORD says ... the rams you burn on the altar
decisions.reason: Readable puts "the LORD says" first and explains what a burnt offering was.

decisions.choice: "asema BWANA" for the formula after God's words
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for *neʾum YHWH* (L, B) serves also for "says the LORD" here; Readable puts it first, "BWANA anasema:", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Que m’[importe]"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "why to me" has no verb; French Literal supplies "importe" in brackets, the closest natural form of the question.

decisions.choice: God says "các ngươi" to the people
decisions.reason: The terms note: God speaking to the people as a group says "các ngươi" at every level; "các con" is kept for where the Hebrew calls them children.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다", without the honorific
decisions.reason: The words "says the LORD" stand inside God's own speech; God names himself without "-시-" (terms note).

decisions.choice: diz o SENHOR
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the short speech formula with "say" in the present is "diz o SENHOR", set inside or after God's words as the Hebrew sets it; ne'um, the solemn formula, is "declara" (1:24). Portuguese, like English, can put the formula after a question without breaking the sentence.

decisions.choice: "says the LORD" (yomar YHWH) inside God's words: "ይላል [[-]]" after the words it marks, at Literal and Balanced; Readable moves it to the front, as the English Readable does
decisions.reason: The prophets break into God's speech with "says the LORD". Amharic can place "ይላል" with its subject after the words, which keeps the Hebrew's interruption; the same wording serves for "declares the LORD" (neʾum YHWH), as the terms list has it.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं
decisions.reason: "Says the LORD" here is the plain verb yomar, not the formula neum YHWH. It is कहते हैं at every level, and the formula keeps its own wording (की यह वाणी है at L and B, 1:24).

decisions.choice: "говорит ГОСПОДЬ" for "says the LORD" (the verb yomar), without quotation marks
decisions.reason: The plain verb "says" is "говорит" at every level; the formula "declares the LORD" (neum) has its own Literal wording, "— слово ГОСПОДА" (verse 24), so the two stay apart. As in the English, God's words in this poem have no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: yomar / 'amar YHWH inside God's own speech ("says the LORD"): "と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う" (L, B), "{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言う" (R), plain, as 2 Kings 20:17. The messenger formula koh 'amar YHWH that introduces an oracle ("Thus says the LORD") is "{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる" at every level, with the light respect form, as Kings.
decisions.reason: Inside the oracle God is the speaker and names himself, so no respect form; the prophet's own introduction honours the one who sends him. Offerings keep the Leviticus forms ("焼き尽くすささげ物" L, B; "焼いてささげる" R).

source.text: כִּ֣י תָבֹ֔אוּ לֵרָא֖וֹת פָּנָ֑י מִי־בִקֵּ֥שׁ זֹ֛את מִיֶּדְכֶ֖ם רְמֹ֥ס חֲצֵרָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: When you come to appear [before] my face, who has required this from your hand, to trample my courts?

en.L: When you come to appear before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q who has required this from your hand, to trample {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} courts?
en.B: You come to stand in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} presence; \q but who told you to do this, to tread down {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} courtyards?
en.R: You come to the temple to stand before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q But I never asked you to bring all this and trample through {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} courtyards.

es.L: Cuando {{plural_you:vienen|venís}} a presentarse delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, \q ¿quién ha pedido esto de {{plural_you:su mano|vuestra mano}}, que {{plural_you:pisoteen|pisoteéis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} atrios?
es.B: {{plural_you:Vienen|Venís}} a estar en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} presencia; \q pero ¿quién {{plural_you:les|os}} pidió esto, que {{plural_you:pisotearan|pisotearais}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} atrios?
es.R: {{plural_you:Vienen|Venís}} al templo a presentarse delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Pero yo nunca {{plural_you:les|os}} pedí que {{plural_you:trajeran|trajerais}} todo esto ni que {{plural_you:anduvieran|anduvierais}} pisoteando {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} atrios.

fr.L: Quand vous venez pour paraître devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, \q qui a réclamé cela de vos mains, de fouler {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} parvis ?
fr.B: Vous venez vous présenter devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; \q mais qui vous a demandé cela, de piétiner {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} parvis ?
fr.R: Vous venez au temple pour vous tenir devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Mais je ne vous ai jamais demandé d’apporter tout cela et de piétiner {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} cours.

sw.L: Mnapokuja kuonekana mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, \q ni nani aliyetaka hili mikononi mwenu, kuzikanyaga nyua {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}?
sw.B: Mnakuja kusimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; \q lakini ni nani aliyewaambia mfanye hivi, kuzikanyaga nyua {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}?
sw.R: Mnakuja hekaluni kusimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Lakini sikuwahi kuwaambia mlete haya yote na kupita mkikanyaga nyua {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.

vi.L: Khi các ngươi đến để ra mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q ai đã đòi hỏi điều này từ tay các ngươi, là giày đạp các sân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?
vi.B: Các ngươi đến đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q nhưng ai đã bảo các ngươi làm điều này, giẫm đạp các sân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}?
vi.R: Các ngươi đến đền thờ để đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Nhưng Ta chưa bao giờ bảo các ngươi đem những thứ ấy đến và giẫm đạp khắp các sân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 너희가 내 얼굴을 뵈러 올 때, \q 누가 너희 손에서 이것을, 내 뜰을 짓밟는 것을 요구했느냐?
ko.B: 너희가 내 앞에 나와 서지만, \q 누가 너희에게 이것을 하라고 했느냐? 내 뜰을 짓밟으라고 했느냐?
ko.R: 너희는 성전에 와서 내 앞에 선다. \q 그러나 나는 너희에게 이 모든 것을 가져와서 내 뜰을 짓밟으라고 한 적이 없다.

pt.L: Quando vocês vêm para se apresentar diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, \q quem exigiu isto das mãos de vocês, pisotear os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} átrios?
pt.B: Vocês vêm para estar na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} presença; \q mas quem lhes pediu isto, que pisoteassem os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} pátios?
pt.R: Vocês vêm ao templo para ficar diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. \q Mas eu nunca pedi que vocês trouxessem tudo isso e andassem pisando nos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} pátios.

am.L: በፊቴ ለመታየት በመጣችሁ ጊዜ፣ \q አደባባዮቼን ትረግጡ ዘንድ ይህን ከእጃችሁ የፈለገ ማን ነው?
am.B: በፊቴ ለመቆም ትመጣላችሁ፤ \q ነገር ግን አደባባዮቼን እንድትረግጡ ይህን እንድታደርጉ ማን ነገራችሁ?
am.R: በፊቴ ለመቆም ወደ ቤተ መቅደሱ ትመጣላችሁ። \q ነገር ግን ይህን ሁሉ ይዛችሁ አደባባዮቼን እንድትረግጡ ፈጽሞ አልጠየቅኋችሁም።

hi.L: जब तुम मेरे सामने उपस्थित होने आते हो, \q तो किसने तुम्हारे हाथ से यह माँगा, कि तुम मेरे आँगनों को रौंदो?
hi.B: तुम मेरे सामने खड़े होने आते हो; \q पर किसने तुमसे यह करने को कहा, मेरे आँगनों को रौंदने को?
hi.R: तुम मंदिर में मेरे सामने खड़े होने आते हो। \q पर मैंने कभी नहीं कहा कि यह सब लाओ और मेरे आँगनों को रौंदते फिरो।

ru.L: Когда вы приходите являться пред {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}} лицо, \q кто требовал этого от вашей руки — топтать {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} дворы?
ru.B: Вы приходите предстать передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}; \q но кто велел вам это — топтать {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} дворы?
ru.R: Вы приходите в храм, чтобы встать передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}. \q Но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} никогда не просил вас приносить всё это и топтать {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} дворы.

ja.L: あなたがたが、わたしの前に現れるために来るとき、 \q だれがあなたがたの手からこれを求めたのか、わたしの庭を踏みにじることを？
ja.B: あなたがたは、わたしの前に出ようとしてやって来る。 \q だが、だれがあなたがたにこんなことを求めたのか、わたしの庭を踏み荒らすことを？
ja.R: あなたたちは、わたしの前に立とうと神殿にやって来る。 \q しかし、わたしは、こんなに多くの物を持って来て、わたしの庭を踏み荒らせとは、一度も言っていない。

decisions.choice: to appear before me: to come to the temple to worship
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of coming to the sanctuary at the feasts (Exodus 23:15, 17; Deuteronomy 16:16). The consonants could also be read "to see my face", and the verb may first have been read that way (Psalm 42:3).

decisions.choice: my courts: the open courtyards of the temple
decisions.reason: Worshipers stood in the temple courtyards with their offerings (Psalm 84:3, 11; 100:4). Without justice their coming is only the trampling of feet, like animals tramping through the courts.

decisions.choice: I never asked you
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question "who has required this?" into the statement it implies, and names the temple.

source.text: לֹ֣א תוֹסִ֗יפוּ הָבִיא֙ מִנְחַת־שָׁ֔וְא קְטֹ֧רֶת תּוֹעֵבָ֛ה הִ֖יא לִ֑י חֹ֤דֶשׁ וְשַׁבָּת֙ קְרֹ֣א מִקְרָ֔א לֹא־אוּכַ֥ל אָ֖וֶן וַעֲצָרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you must again bring an offering of emptiness; incense, an abomination it [is] to me. New moon and sabbath, [the] calling of assembly: not I can [bear] iniquity and solemn assembly.

en.L: Do not again bring an offering of emptiness; \q incense is an abomination to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q New moon and Sabbath, the calling of an assembly: \q I cannot bear wickedness and a solemn assembly.
en.B: Bring no more empty gifts; \q to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} the smoke of incense is loathsome. \q New moon, Sabbath, the call to assemble: \q wrongdoing and holy gatherings together are more than I can bear.
en.R: Stop bringing {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} offerings that mean nothing. \q I hate the smell of your incense. \q You keep the new moon festivals and the Sabbath days. You call people together to worship. \q But you also do evil things, and I cannot stand worship mixed with evil.

es.L: No {{plural_you:sigan trayendo|sigáis trayendo}} ofrenda vana; \q el incienso es una abominación para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Luna nueva y sábado, el convocar asamblea: \q no soporto maldad junto con asamblea solemne.
es.B: No {{plural_you:traigan|traigáis}} más ofrendas vacías; \q para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} el humo del incienso es repugnante. \q Luna nueva, sábado, el llamado a reunirse: \q la maldad junto con las reuniones santas es más de lo que puedo soportar.
es.R: No {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:traigan|traigáis}} más ofrendas que no significan nada. \q Odio el olor de {{plural_you:su incienso|vuestro incienso}}. \q {{plural_you:Celebran|Celebráis}} las fiestas de luna nueva y los sábados. {{plural_you:Convocan|Convocáis}} a la gente para adorar. \q Pero también {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} el mal, y no soporto la adoración mezclada con la maldad.

fr.L: Ne continuez pas à apporter une offrande de néant ; \q l’encens est une abomination pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Nouvelle lune et sabbat, convocation d’assemblée : \q je ne peux supporter l’iniquité et l’assemblée solennelle.
fr.B: N’apportez plus d’offrandes vides ; \q la fumée de l’encens {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}est odieuse. \q Nouvelle lune, sabbat, appel à se rassembler : \q le mal uni aux fêtes saintes, je ne le supporte plus.
fr.R: Arrêtez de {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}apporter des offrandes qui ne veulent rien dire. \q Je déteste l’odeur de votre encens. \q Vous célébrez les fêtes de la nouvelle lune et les jours de sabbat. Vous appelez les gens à se rassembler pour le culte. \q Mais vous faites aussi le mal, et je ne supporte pas un culte mêlé de mal.

sw.L: Msilete tena sadaka ya ubatili; \q uvumba ni chukizo {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}. \q Mwandamo wa mwezi na sabato, kuitisha kusanyiko: \q siwezi [kuvumilia] uovu pamoja na mkutano wa ibada.
sw.B: Msilete tena matoleo yasiyo na maana; \q moshi wa uvumba ni chukizo {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}. \q Mwandamo wa mwezi, sabato, mwito wa kukusanyika: \q siwezi kuvumilia uovu pamoja na makusanyiko matakatifu.
sw.R: Acheni kuniletea sadaka zisizo na maana. \q Nachukia harufu ya uvumba wenu. \q Mnashika sikukuu za mwezi mpya na siku za sabato. Mnaita watu wakusanyike kuabudu. \q Lakini pia mnatenda maovu, nami siwezi kuvumilia ibada iliyochanganyika na uovu.

vi.L: Đừng đem đến nữa của lễ hư không; \q hương [là] điều ghê tởm đối với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ngày trăng mới và ngày Sa-bát, việc triệu tập hội chúng: \q Ta không chịu nổi gian ác cùng với lễ trọng thể.
vi.B: Đừng mang đến những lễ vật vô nghĩa nữa; \q với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, khói hương thật đáng ghê tởm. \q Ngày trăng mới, ngày Sa-bát, những lời kêu gọi nhóm họp: \q tội ác đi cùng lễ hội thánh là điều Ta không chịu nổi.
vi.R: Đừng đem đến cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} những lễ vật vô nghĩa nữa. \q Ta ghét mùi hương các ngươi đốt. \q Các ngươi giữ lễ trăng mới và ngày Sa-bát. Các ngươi triệu tập dân chúng lại để thờ phượng. \q Nhưng các ngươi cũng làm điều ác, và Ta không chịu nổi sự thờ phượng lẫn với điều ác.

ko.L: 헛된 예물을 다시는 가져오지 마라. \q 분향은 나에게 역겨운 것이다. \q 초하루와 안식일과 대회로 모이는 것, \q 나는 악과 성회를 [견딜 수] 없다.
ko.B: 더 이상 헛된 예물을 가져오지 마라. \q 분향하는 연기도 나에게는 역겹다. \q 초하루와 안식일과 모이라는 소집, \q 악을 행하면서 거룩한 모임을 갖는 것을 나는 견딜 수 없다.
ko.R: 아무 의미 없는 예물을 나에게 가져오지 마라. \q 나는 너희가 피우는 향 냄새가 싫다. \q 너희는 초하루 절기와 안식일을 지키고 사람들을 불러 모아 예배한다. \q 그러나 너희는 악한 일도 한다. 악과 뒤섞인 예배를 나는 참을 수 없다.

pt.L: Não continuem trazendo oferta vã; \q o incenso é abominação para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. \q Lua nova e sábado, a convocação de assembleia: \q não posso suportar iniquidade e reunião solene.
pt.B: Não tragam mais ofertas vazias; \q a fumaça do incenso {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dá nojo. \q Lua nova, sábado, convocação para a assembleia: \q maldade junto com reuniões sagradas é mais do que eu posso suportar.
pt.R: Parem de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} trazer ofertas que não significam nada. \q Eu odeio o cheiro do incenso de vocês. \q Vocês guardam as festas da lua nova e os sábados. Vocês chamam o povo para adorar. \q Mas também fazem coisas más, e eu não aguento adoração misturada com maldade.

am.L: ከንቱ መባ ደግማችሁ አታምጡ፤ \q ዕጣን ለእኔ አስጸያፊ ነው። \q የወር መባቻና ሰንበት፣ ጉባኤ መጥራት፤ \q ኃጢአትንና የተከበረ ጉባኤን [አብሮ] መሸከም አልችልም።
am.B: ከእንግዲህ ከንቱ ስጦታ አታምጡ፤ \q የዕጣን ጢስ በእኔ ዘንድ አስጸያፊ ነው። \q የወር መባቻ፣ ሰንበት፣ ለጉባኤ የሚደረግ ጥሪ፤ \q ክፋትና የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ በአንድነት ሲሆኑ ልታገሣቸው አልችልም።
am.R: ትርጉም የሌለው መባ ማምጣታችሁን አቁሙ። \q የዕጣናችሁን ሽታ እጠላለሁ። \q የወር መባቻ በዓላችሁንና ሰንበትን ታከብራላችሁ። ሰዎችን ለአምልኮ ትጠራላችሁ። \q ነገር ግን ክፉ ነገርም ታደርጋላችሁ፤ ከክፋት ጋር የተቀላቀለ አምልኮን ልታገሥ አልችልም።

hi.L: व्यर्थ की भेंट फिर न लाना; \q धूप मेरे लिए घृणित है। \q नया चाँद और सब्त, सभा का बुलाया जाना: \q मैं अधर्म और पवित्र सभा [साथ-साथ] सह नहीं सकता।
hi.B: अब और खोखली भेंटें मत लाओ; \q धूप का धुआँ मुझे घिनौना लगता है। \q नया चाँद, सब्त, इकट्ठा होने की पुकार: \q बुराई और पवित्र सभाएँ एक साथ, यह मुझसे सहा नहीं जाता।
hi.R: मेरे पास ऐसी भेंटें लाना बंद करो जिनका कोई अर्थ नहीं। \q मुझे तुम्हारे धूप की गंध से घृणा है। \q तुम नए चाँद के पर्व और सब्त के दिन मनाते हो। तुम लोगों को आराधना के लिए इकट्ठा करते हो। \q पर तुम बुरे काम भी करते हो, और मैं बुराई से मिली हुई आराधना सह नहीं सकता।

ru.L: Не приносите больше пустого приношения; \q курение — мерзость оно для {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. \q Новолуние и суббота, созывание собрания: \q не могу [терпеть] беззаконие и торжественное собрание.
ru.B: Не приносите больше пустых даров; \q дым благовоний {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} отвратителен. \q Новолуние, суббота, созыв собраний — \q беззаконие вместе со священными собраниями {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} вынести не могу.
ru.R: Перестаньте приносить {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} бессмысленные дары. \q Мне противен запах ваших благовоний. \q Вы соблюдаете праздники новолуния и субботы. Вы созываете людей на поклонение. \q Но вы делаете и зло, а поклонение вместе со злом {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} терпеть не могу.

ja.L: 空しいささげ物を、もう携えて来るな。 \q 香は、わたしの忌み嫌うものだ。 \q 新月と安息日、集会の呼び集め―― \q わたしは不法と聖なる集会[が共にあること]に耐えられない。
ja.B: 中身のないささげ物を、もう持って来てはならない。 \q 香の煙は、わたしには忌まわしい。 \q 新月祭、安息日、集会への呼びかけ―― \q 悪を行いながらの聖なる集まりに、わたしは耐えられない。
ja.R: 意味のないささげ物を、もう持って来てはいけない。 \q あなたたちのたく香のにおいが、わたしは大嫌いだ。 \q あなたたちは、新月の祭りや安息日を守り、人々を集めて礼拝する。 \q しかし、悪いこともしている。悪と混ざった礼拝に、わたしは耐えられない。

decisions.choice: an offering of emptiness: a gift that means nothing
decisions.reason: The offering is the gift brought to God, often of grain (Leviticus 2). "Emptiness" means what is worthless or false: the gift has no value because the giver's life denies it.

decisions.choice: new moon and Sabbath: the monthly and weekly holy days
decisions.reason: The first day of each month and the seventh day of each week were kept with offerings and rest (Numbers 28:9-15; Amos 8:5).

decisions.choice: wickedness and solemn assembly: worship and evil side by side
decisions.reason: The two nouns are joined: God cannot bear sacred gatherings kept by people who do wrong. The Septuagint has "fasting and idleness" here, reading a different word for the first one.

decisions.choice: you also do evil things ... worship mixed with evil
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the joining of wickedness and worship in short sentences.

decisions.choice: new moon "የወር መባቻ"; solemn assembly "የተከበረ ጉባኤ" (L); abomination (toʿevah) "አስጸያፊ"
decisions.reason: The festival words keep the forms of Numbers, Chronicles and 2 Kings 10:20 on main.

source.text: חָדְשֵׁיכֶ֤ם וּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם֙ שָׂנְאָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֔י הָי֥וּ עָלַ֖י לָטֹ֑רַח נִלְאֵ֖יתִי נְשֹֽׂא׃

records.literal_gloss: Your new moons and your appointed feasts hates my soul; they have become on me a burden; I am weary of bearing [them].

en.L: Your new moons and your appointed feasts {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul hates; \q they have become a burden upon {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; \q I am weary of carrying [them].
en.B: Your new moons and your fixed feasts are hateful to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, to the depths of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} soul; \q they lie on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} like a heavy load, \q and I am tired of carrying it.
en.R: I truly hate your new moon festivals and your other holy days. \q They have become a heavy load for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I am tired of carrying it.

es.L: {{plural_you:Sus lunas nuevas|Vuestras lunas nuevas}} y {{plural_you:sus fiestas señaladas|vuestras fiestas señaladas}} las aborrece {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma; \q se han vuelto una carga sobre {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; \q estoy cansado de llevar[las].
es.B: {{plural_you:Sus lunas nuevas|Vuestras lunas nuevas}} y {{plural_you:sus fiestas fijas|vuestras fiestas fijas}} {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} son odiosas, hasta lo más hondo de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} alma; \q pesan sobre {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} como una carga pesada, \q y estoy cansado de llevarla.
es.R: Odio de verdad {{plural_you:sus fiestas|vuestras fiestas}} de luna nueva y {{plural_you:sus otros días|vuestros otros días}} santos. \q Se han vuelto una carga pesada para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y estoy cansado de llevarla.

fr.L: Vos nouvelles lunes et vos fêtes fixées, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme les hait ; \q elles sont devenues un fardeau pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; \q je suis las de [les] porter.
fr.B: Vos nouvelles lunes et vos fêtes, je les hais du fond de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} âme ; \q elles pèsent sur {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} comme une lourde charge, \q et je suis fatigué de la porter.
fr.R: Je déteste vraiment vos fêtes de la nouvelle lune et vos autres jours saints. \q Ils sont devenus une lourde charge pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et je suis fatigué de la porter.

sw.L: Miandamo yenu ya mwezi na sikukuu zenu zilizoamriwa nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} inazichukia; \q zimekuwa mzigo juu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; \q nimechoka kuzibeba.
sw.B: Miandamo yenu ya mwezi na sikukuu zenu zilizopangwa nazichukia, hadi ndani ya nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; \q zimekuwa juu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kama mzigo mzito, \q nami nimechoka kuubeba.
sw.R: Nazichukia kweli sikukuu zenu za mwezi mpya na siku zenu nyingine takatifu. \q Zimekuwa mzigo mzito {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, nami nimechoka kuubeba.

vi.L: Ngày trăng mới và các kỳ lễ đã định của các ngươi, linh hồn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ghét; \q chúng đã thành gánh nặng trên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q Ta mệt mỏi vì mang [chúng].
vi.B: Ngày trăng mới và các kỳ lễ của các ngươi, Ta ghét tận đáy lòng; \q chúng đè nặng trên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như một gánh nặng, \q và Ta đã mỏi mệt vì phải mang nó.
vi.R: Ta thật ghét những lễ trăng mới và những ngày lễ khác của các ngươi. \q Chúng đã thành gánh nặng cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và Ta mệt mỏi vì phải mang nó.

ko.L: 너희의 초하루들과 너희의 정한 절기들을 내 영혼이 미워한다. \q 그것들이 나에게 짐이 되었다. \q 나는 [그것들을] 지기에 지쳤다.
ko.B: 너희의 초하루 축제와 정해진 절기들을 나는 마음속 깊이 미워한다. \q 그것들이 나에게 무거운 짐이 되어, \q 나는 그 짐을 지기에 지쳤다.
ko.R: 나는 너희의 초하루 절기와 다른 거룩한 날들이 정말 싫다. \q 그것들은 나에게 무거운 짐이 되었다. 나는 그 짐을 지는 데 지쳤다.

pt.L: As luas novas de vocês e as suas festas fixas, a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} alma [as] odeia; \q tornaram-se um fardo sobre {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}; \q estou cansado de [as] carregar.
pt.B: Odeio do fundo da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} alma as luas novas e as festas fixas de vocês; \q pesam sobre {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} como um fardo, \q e estou cansado de carregá-lo.
pt.R: Eu odeio de verdade as festas da lua nova de vocês e os seus outros dias santos. \q Tudo isso se tornou uma carga pesada para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, e estou cansado de carregá-la.

am.L: መባቻዎቻችሁንና የተወሰኑ በዓሎቻችሁን ነፍሴ ጠልታለች፤ \q በእኔ ላይ ሸክም ሆነውብኛል፤ \q መሸከም ደክሞኛል።
am.B: መባቻዎቻችሁና የተወሰኑ በዓሎቻችሁ በእኔ ዘንድ የተጠሉ ናቸው፤ ከነፍሴ ጥልቅ እጠላቸዋለሁ፤ \q እንደ ከባድ ሸክም ተጭነውብኛል፤ \q መሸከሙም ታከተኝ።
am.R: የወር መባቻ በዓላችሁንና ሌሎች የተቀደሱ ቀኖቻችሁን ፈጽሞ እጠላለሁ። \q ከባድ ሸክም ሆነውብኛል፤ መሸከሙም ደክሞኛል።

hi.L: तुम्हारे नए चाँदों और तुम्हारे नियत पर्वों से मेरा प्राण घृणा करता है; \q वे मुझ पर बोझ बन गए हैं; \q मैं [उन्हें] उठाते-उठाते थक गया हूँ।
hi.B: तुम्हारे नए चाँद और तुम्हारे नियत पर्व मुझे अपने प्राण की गहराई तक घिनौने लगते हैं; \q वे मुझ पर भारी बोझ की तरह पड़े हैं, \q और मैं उसे ढोते-ढोते थक गया हूँ।
hi.R: मुझे तुम्हारे नए चाँद के पर्वों और तुम्हारे दूसरे पवित्र दिनों से सचमुच घृणा है। \q वे मेरे लिए भारी बोझ बन गए हैं, और मैं उसे ढोते-ढोते थक गया हूँ।

ru.L: Ваши новолуния и ваши праздники ненавидит {{deity_pronoun:моя|Моя}} душа; \q они стали {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} бременем; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} устал нести [их].
ru.B: Ваши новолуния и ваши установленные праздники {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} ненавистны до глубины {{deity_pronoun:моей|Моей}} души; \q они лежат на {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} тяжким грузом, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} устал его нести.
ru.R: Я всем сердцем ненавижу ваши праздники новолуния и другие ваши праздники. \q Они стали для {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} тяжёлым грузом, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} устал его нести.

ja.L: あなたがたの新月とあなたがたの定めの祭りを、わたしの魂は憎む。 \q それらはわたしの上で重荷となった。 \q わたしは[それを]担うのに疲れた。
ja.B: あなたがたの新月祭と定めの祭りを、わたしは心の底から憎む。 \q それらは重荷となって、わたしにのしかかり、 \q わたしはそれを担うのに疲れ果てた。
ja.R: あなたたちの新月の祭りや、そのほかの祭りの日が、わたしは本当に嫌いだ。 \q それはわたしにとって重い荷物になった。わたしはそれを担うのに疲れた。

decisions.choice: my soul hates: I hate with my whole self
decisions.reason: The "soul" is the self, the whole living person. "My soul hates" is stronger than "I hate" (compare Leviticus 26:11, 30; Psalm 11:5).

decisions.choice: your new moons and your feasts: no longer God's feasts but theirs
decisions.reason: In the Law these are "my appointed feasts", the feasts of Yahweh (Leviticus 23:2). Kept without justice, they have become the people's own and no longer honor God (compare Amos 5:21).

decisions.choice: truly hate
decisions.reason: Readable gives the force of "my soul hates" without the word "soul".

source.text: וּבְפָרִשְׂכֶ֣ם כַּפֵּיכֶ֗ם אַעְלִ֤ים עֵינַי֙ מִכֶּ֔ם גַּ֛ם כִּֽי־תַרְבּ֥וּ תְפִלָּ֖ה אֵינֶ֣נִּי שֹׁמֵ֑עַ יְדֵיכֶ֖ם דָּמִ֥ים מָלֵֽאוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And when you spread out your palms, I will hide my eyes from you; even though you multiply prayer, not I [am] listening; your hands [with] blood are full.

en.L: And when you spread out your palms, I will hide {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes from you; \q even when you multiply prayer, I am not listening. \q Your hands are full of blood.
en.B: Spread out your palms, and I will hide {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes from you; \q pile up prayer upon prayer, and I will not be listening. \q Blood fills your hands.
en.R: When you raise your hands to pray, I will look away. \q You may pray many prayers, but I will not listen. \q Your hands are covered with blood from the violence you do.

es.L: Y cuando {{plural_you:extiendan sus palmas|extendáis vuestras palmas}}, esconderé de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos; \q aunque {{plural_you:multipliquen|multipliquéis}} la oración, no estoy escuchando. \q {{plural_you:Sus manos están|Vuestras manos están}} llenas de sangre.
es.B: {{plural_you:Extiendan|Extended}} las palmas, y esconderé de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos; \q {{plural_you:amontonen|amontonad}} oración sobre oración, y no estaré escuchando. \q La sangre llena {{plural_you:sus manos|vuestras manos}}.
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:levanten|levantéis}} las manos para orar, apartaré la mirada. \q Aunque {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} muchas oraciones, no {{plural_you:los|os}} escucharé. \q {{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} las manos cubiertas de la sangre de la violencia que {{plural_you:cometen|cometéis}}.

fr.L: Et quand vous étendez vos paumes, je cache {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux loin de vous ; \q même quand vous multipliez la prière, je n’écoute pas. \q Vos mains sont pleines de sang.
fr.B: Étendez vos mains, et je détournerai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux de vous ; \q multipliez prière sur prière, et je n’écouterai pas. \q Le sang remplit vos mains.
fr.R: Quand vous levez les mains pour prier, je regarderai ailleurs. \q Vous pouvez faire beaucoup de prières, je n’écouterai pas. \q Vos mains sont couvertes du sang des violences que vous commettez.

sw.L: Nanyi mnaponyosha viganja vyenu, nitayaficha macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} msiyaone; \q hata mkizidisha maombi, sisikilizi. \q Mikono yenu imejaa damu.
sw.B: Nyosheni viganja vyenu, nami nitayaficha macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; \q rundikeni maombi juu ya maombi, nami sitasikiliza. \q Damu imejaa mikononi mwenu.
sw.R: Mnapoinua mikono yenu kuomba, nitageuza uso wangu. \q Mnaweza kuomba maombi mengi, lakini sitasikiliza. \q Mikono yenu imejaa damu kwa sababu ya ukatili mnaoufanya.

vi.L: Khi các ngươi giang lòng bàn tay ra, Ta sẽ che mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khỏi các ngươi; \q dù các ngươi cầu nguyện nhiều, Ta cũng không nghe. \q Tay các ngươi đầy máu.
vi.B: Các ngươi giơ tay lên, Ta sẽ che mắt không nhìn các ngươi; \q các ngươi cầu nguyện bao nhiêu, Ta cũng chẳng nghe. \q Máu đầy tay các ngươi.
vi.R: Khi các ngươi giơ tay lên cầu nguyện, Ta sẽ quay mặt đi. \q Dù các ngươi cầu nguyện nhiều, Ta cũng không nghe. \q Tay các ngươi dính đầy máu vì những điều hung bạo các ngươi đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 너희가 손바닥을 펼 때에 내가 너희에게서 내 눈을 가리고, \q 너희가 기도를 많이 할지라도 나는 듣지 않는다. \q 너희 손에는 피가 가득하다.
ko.B: 너희가 손을 펴고 기도해도 나는 너희를 보지 않고 눈을 가리겠다. \q 기도를 거듭거듭 드려도 나는 듣지 않겠다. \q 너희 손에 피가 가득하다.
ko.R: 너희가 기도하려고 손을 들어도 나는 눈을 돌려 버리겠다. \q 너희가 아무리 기도를 많이 해도 나는 듣지 않겠다. \q 너희 손은 너희가 사람들을 해친 피로 물들어 있다.

pt.L: E, quando vocês estendem as palmas das mãos, esconderei de vocês os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos; \q mesmo quando multiplicam a oração, eu não estou ouvindo. \q As mãos de vocês estão cheias de sangue.
pt.B: Estendam as palmas das mãos, e eu esconderei de vocês os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos; \q amontoem oração sobre oração, e eu não estarei ouvindo. \q O sangue enche as mãos de vocês.
pt.R: Quando vocês levantarem as mãos para orar, eu vou olhar para outro lado. \q Vocês podem fazer muitas orações, mas eu não vou ouvir. \q As mãos de vocês estão cobertas de sangue, por causa da violência que vocês praticam.

am.L: እጆቻችሁንም በዘረጋችሁ ጊዜ ዓይኖቼን ከእናንተ እሰውራለሁ፤ \q ጸሎትንም ብታበዙ እንኳ አልሰማም። \q እጆቻችሁ ደም የሞላባቸው ናቸው።
am.B: መዳፋችሁን ዘርጉ፤ እኔም ዓይኖቼን ከእናንተ እሰውራለሁ። \q በጸሎት ላይ ጸሎት ጨምሩ፤ እኔ ግን አልሰማም። \q እጆቻችሁ በደም ተሞልተዋል።
am.R: ለመጸለይ እጆቻችሁን ስታነሡ ፊቴን አዞራለሁ። \q ብዙ ጸሎት ብትጸልዩም አልሰማችሁም። \q በምትፈጽሙት ግፍ እጆቻችሁ በደም ተሸፍነዋል።

hi.L: और जब तुम अपनी हथेलियाँ फैलाओगे, तब मैं तुमसे अपनी आँखें छिपा लूँगा; \q चाहे तुम बहुत प्रार्थना करो, मैं नहीं सुन रहा। \q तुम्हारे हाथ लहू से भरे हैं।
hi.B: तुम अपनी हथेलियाँ फैलाओ, और मैं तुमसे अपनी आँखें फेर लूँगा; \q प्रार्थना पर प्रार्थना करो, तो भी मैं नहीं सुनूँगा। \q तुम्हारे हाथों में लहू भरा है।
hi.R: जब तुम प्रार्थना करने के लिए अपने हाथ उठाओगे, तब मैं अपनी आँखें फेर लूँगा। \q तुम चाहे कितनी ही प्रार्थनाएँ करो, मैं नहीं सुनूँगा। \q तुम्हारे हाथ उस लहू से सने हैं जो तुम्हारी हिंसा ने बहाया है।

ru.L: И когда вы простираете ваши ладони, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} скрываю {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} глаза от вас; \q даже когда вы умножаете молитву, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не слушаю. \q Ваши руки полны крови.
ru.B: Простирайте ладони — {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} закрою от вас глаза; \q умножайте молитву за молитвой — {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не буду слушать. \q Кровь наполняет ваши руки.
ru.R: Когда вы поднимаете руки в молитве, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду отводить взгляд. \q Вы можете молиться много, но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не стану слушать. \q Ваши руки в крови от насилия, которое вы творите.

ja.L: あなたがたが手のひらを広げるとき、わたしはあなたがたから目を隠す。 \q あなたがたが祈りを重ねても、わたしは聞いていない。 \q あなたがたの手は血で満ちている。
ja.B: あなたがたが手のひらを広げても、わたしは目を背ける。 \q どれほど祈りを積み重ねても、わたしは聞かない。 \q あなたがたの手は血にまみれている。
ja.R: あなたたちが祈ろうとして手を上げても、わたしは目をそらす。 \q たくさん祈っても、わたしは聞かない。 \q あなたたちの手は、人を傷つけて流させた血でいっぱいだ。

decisions.choice: spread out your palms: the posture of prayer
decisions.reason: People prayed standing with open hands lifted toward heaven (Exodus 9:29; 1 Kings 8:22, 38).

decisions.choice: blood: bloodshed, violence against people
decisions.reason: The plural form of "blood" means blood shed by violence and the guilt of it (Exodus 22:1; Isaiah 59:3). Verses 17, 21 and 23 show who has been harmed: the orphan, the widow, the victims of murderers. It also stands against the blood of the sacrifices in verse 11.

decisions.choice: I am not listening: God goes on refusing to hear
decisions.reason: The participle describes a settled state: while they keep praying, God keeps not listening (compare 59:2).

decisions.choice: blood from the violence you do
decisions.reason: Readable explains that the blood is from violence against people, not from the sacrifices (meaning decision m2).

source.text: רַחֲצוּ֙ הִזַּכּ֔וּ הָסִ֛ירוּ רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם מִנֶּ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י חִדְל֖וּ הָרֵֽעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Wash, make yourselves clean; remove [the] evil of your deeds from before my eyes; cease to do evil.

en.L: Wash, make yourselves clean; \q remove the evil of your deeds from before {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes; \q cease to do evil.
en.B: Wash, and be clean again! \q Clear your wicked deeds away from before {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes. \q Put an end to evil.
en.R: Wash yourselves and become clean! \q Get rid of the evil things you do. I do not want to see them anymore. \q Stop doing evil.

es.L: {{plural_you:Lávense, purifíquense|Lavaos, purificaos}}; \q {{plural_you:quiten|quitad}} la maldad de {{plural_you:sus obras|vuestras obras}} de delante de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos; \q {{plural_you:dejen|dejad}} de hacer el mal.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Lávense y vuelvan|Lavaos y volved}} a estar limpios! \q {{plural_you:Aparten sus malas obras|Apartad vuestras malas obras}} de delante de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos. \q {{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}} fin al mal.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Lávense y queden|Lavaos y quedad}} limpios! \q {{plural_you:Dejen las cosas malas que hacen|Dejad las cosas malas que hacéis}}. No quiero verlas más. \q {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de hacer el mal.

fr.L: Lavez-vous, purifiez-vous ; \q ôtez la méchanceté de vos actions de devant {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux ; \q cessez de faire le mal.
fr.B: Lavez-vous et redevenez purs ! \q Écartez vos actions mauvaises de devant {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux. \q Mettez fin au mal.
fr.R: Lavez-vous et devenez purs ! \q Débarrassez-vous du mal que vous faites. Je ne veux plus le voir. \q Arrêtez de faire le mal.

sw.L: Jiosheni, jitakaseni; \q ondoeni uovu wa matendo yenu mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}; \q acheni kutenda mabaya.
sw.B: Jiosheni, mwe safi tena! \q Yaondoeni matendo yenu maovu mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Acheni kutenda maovu.
sw.R: Jiosheni na kuwa safi! \q Acheni mambo maovu mnayoyafanya. Sitaki kuyaona tena. \q Acheni kutenda maovu.

vi.L: Hãy tắm rửa, hãy làm cho mình tinh sạch; \q hãy dẹp bỏ điều ác trong việc làm của các ngươi khỏi trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q hãy thôi làm điều ác.
vi.B: Hãy tắm rửa và trở nên tinh sạch! \q Hãy dẹp những việc gian ác của các ngươi khỏi trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Hãy chấm dứt điều ác.
vi.R: Hãy tắm rửa cho sạch! \q Hãy bỏ hết những việc ác các ngươi làm. Ta không muốn thấy chúng nữa. \q Đừng làm điều ác nữa.

ko.L: 씻어라, 너희 자신을 깨끗하게 하여라. \q 너희 행실의 악을 내 눈앞에서 없애라. \q 악을 행하기를 그쳐라.
ko.B: 씻어라, 다시 깨끗해져라! \q 너희의 악한 행실을 내 눈앞에서 치워 버려라. \q 악한 일을 그만두어라.
ko.R: 너희 몸을 씻고 깨끗해져라! \q 너희가 하는 악한 일들을 없애라. 나는 그것을 더는 보고 싶지 않다. \q 악한 일을 그만두어라.

pt.L: Lavem-se, tornem-se puros; \q removam de diante dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos o mal das suas ações; \q deixem de praticar o mal.
pt.B: Lavem-se e fiquem limpos de novo! \q Tirem da frente dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos as suas obras perversas. \q Acabem com o mal.
pt.R: Lavem-se e fiquem limpos! \q Livrem-se das coisas más que vocês fazem. Eu não quero mais vê-las. \q Parem de fazer o mal.

am.L: ታጠቡ፤ ራሳችሁን አንጹ፤ \q የሥራችሁን ክፋት ከዓይኖቼ ፊት አስወግዱ፤ \q ክፉ ማድረግን ተዉ።
am.B: ታጠቡ፤ እንደ ገናም ንጹሓን ሁኑ! \q ክፉ ሥራችሁን ከዓይኖቼ ፊት አስወግዱ። \q ክፋትን አቁሙ።
am.R: ራሳችሁን ታጠቡ፤ ንጹሓንም ሁኑ! \q የምታደርጉትን ክፉ ነገር አስወግዱ። ከእንግዲህ ማየት አልፈልግም። \q ክፉ ማድረግን አቁሙ።

hi.L: नहाओ, अपने आप को शुद्ध करो; \q अपने कामों की बुराई मेरी आँखों के सामने से दूर करो; \q बुराई करना छोड़ो।
hi.B: धोओ, और फिर से शुद्ध हो जाओ! \q अपने बुरे कामों को मेरी आँखों के सामने से हटा दो। \q बुराई का अंत करो।
hi.R: अपने आप को धोकर शुद्ध करो! \q जो बुरे काम तुम करते हो, उन्हें छोड़ दो। मैं उन्हें अब और देखना नहीं चाहता। \q बुराई करना बंद करो।

ru.L: Омойтесь, очиститесь; \q уберите зло ваших дел от {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} глаз; \q перестаньте делать зло.
ru.B: Омойтесь и станьте снова чистыми! \q Уберите ваши злые дела с {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} глаз. \q Положите конец злу.
ru.R: Вымойтесь и станьте чистыми! \q Избавьтесь от зла, которое вы делаете. Я больше не хочу его видеть. \q Перестаньте делать зло.

ja.L: 洗え、身を清めよ。 \q あなたがたの悪い行いを、わたしの目の前から取り除け。 \q 悪を行うのをやめよ。
ja.B: 身を洗って、清くなりなさい。 \q あなたがたの悪い行いを、わたしの目の前から取り除きなさい。 \q 悪を行うのをやめなさい。
ja.R: 体を洗って、きれいになりなさい！ \q あなたたちのしている悪いことを捨てなさい。わたしはもう、それを見たくない。 \q 悪いことをするのをやめなさい。

decisions.choice: wash, make yourselves clean: turn from your sins
decisions.reason: Washing was part of becoming ritually clean (Leviticus 14:8-9). Here it pictures a moral cleansing: hands full of blood (verse 15) are to be washed by turning from evil (Psalm 51:4, 9; Jeremiah 4:14).

decisions.choice: a series of commands running into verse 17
decisions.reason: Nine commands follow one another without a break, from "wash" to "plead for the widow". The first four say turn from evil; the last five say do good.

source.text: לִמְד֥וּ הֵיטֵ֛ב דִּרְשׁ֥וּ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט אַשְּׁר֣וּ חָמ֑וֹץ שִׁפְט֣וּ יָת֔וֹם רִ֖יבוּ אַלְמָנָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Learn to do good; seek justice; set right [the] oppressor; judge [the] fatherless; plead [for the] widow.

en.L: Learn to do good; seek justice; set right the oppressor; \q defend the fatherless; plead the widow's case.
en.B: Learn to do good. Go after justice. Set the oppressor straight. \q Give the fatherless child a fair hearing; stand up for the widow in court.
en.R: Learn to do what is good. Work hard to make things fair. Stop people who mistreat others. \q Defend the rights of children whose fathers have died. Speak up for widows when they are treated unfairly.

es.L: {{plural_you:Aprendan|Aprended}} a hacer el bien; {{plural_you:busquen|buscad}} la justicia; {{plural_you:corrijan|corregid}} al opresor; \q {{plural_you:defiendan|defended}} al huérfano; {{plural_you:aboguen|abogad}} por la viuda.
es.B: {{plural_you:Aprendan|Aprended}} a hacer el bien. {{plural_you:Procuren|Procurad}} la justicia. {{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}} en su sitio al opresor. \q {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} justicia al niño huérfano; {{plural_you:defiendan|defended}} a la viuda en el tribunal.
es.R: {{plural_you:Aprendan|Aprended}} a hacer lo bueno. {{plural_you:Esfuércense|Esforzaos}} para que haya justicia. {{plural_you:Detengan|Detened}} a los que maltratan a otros. \q {{plural_you:Defiendan|Defended}} los derechos de los niños que no tienen padre. {{plural_you:Hablen|Hablad}} a favor de las viudas cuando las traten injustamente.

fr.L: Apprenez à faire le bien ; recherchez le droit ; redressez l’oppresseur ; \q faites droit à l’orphelin ; plaidez la cause de la veuve.
fr.B: Apprenez à faire le bien. Recherchez la justice. Remettez l’oppresseur dans le droit chemin. \q Rendez justice à l’orphelin ; défendez la veuve au tribunal.
fr.R: Apprenez à faire ce qui est bien. Faites tout pour que chacun soit traité avec justice. Arrêtez ceux qui maltraitent les autres. \q Défendez les droits des enfants dont le père est mort. Prenez la parole pour les veuves quand on les traite injustement.

sw.L: Jifunzeni kutenda mema; tafuteni haki; mrekebisheni mdhalimu; \q mtetee yatima; mtetee mjane katika shauri lake.
sw.B: Jifunzeni kutenda mema. Ifuatieni haki. Mnyoosheni mdhalimu. \q Mpatieni yatima hukumu ya haki; simameni upande wa mjane mahakamani.
sw.R: Jifunzeni kufanya yaliyo mema. Fanyeni bidii watu watendewe haki. Wazuieni wanaowaonea wengine. \q Teteeni haki za watoto ambao baba zao wamekufa. Wasemeeni wajane wanapotendewa isivyo haki.

vi.L: Hãy học làm điều lành; hãy tìm kiếm công lý; hãy sửa trị kẻ áp bức; \q hãy xét xử cho kẻ mồ côi; hãy biện hộ cho người góa bụa.
vi.B: Hãy học làm điều tốt. Hãy theo đuổi công lý. Hãy sửa trị kẻ áp bức. \q Hãy bênh vực quyền lợi của trẻ mồ côi; hãy đứng ra bào chữa cho người góa bụa.
vi.R: Hãy học làm điều tốt. Hãy cố gắng làm cho mọi việc được công bằng. Hãy ngăn chặn những kẻ áp bức người khác. \q Hãy bảo vệ quyền lợi của những đứa trẻ mồ côi cha. Hãy lên tiếng bênh vực người góa bụa khi họ bị đối xử bất công.

ko.L: 선을 행하기를 배워라. 정의를 구하여라. 억압하는 자를 바로잡아라. \q 고아를 변호하여라. 과부의 송사를 맡아라.
ko.B: 선한 일 하기를 배워라. 정의를 찾아라. 억압하는 사람을 바로잡아라. \q 고아의 권리를 지켜 주고, 법정에서 과부의 편을 들어 주어라.
ko.R: 옳은 일 하는 것을 배워라. 공정한 세상을 만들려고 애써라. 남을 괴롭히는 사람들을 막아라. \q 아버지를 잃은 아이들의 권리를 지켜 주어라. 억울한 일을 당하는 과부들의 편에 서서 말해 주어라.

pt.L: Aprendam a fazer o bem; busquem a justiça; corrijam o opressor; \q façam justiça ao órfão; defendam a causa da viúva.
pt.B: Aprendam a fazer o bem. Corram atrás da justiça. Ponham o opressor no caminho certo. \q Deem ao órfão um julgamento justo; defendam a viúva no tribunal.
pt.R: Aprendam a fazer o que é bom. Esforcem-se para que tudo seja justo. Façam parar quem maltrata os outros. \q Defendam os direitos das crianças que perderam o pai. Falem a favor das viúvas quando elas forem tratadas com injustiça.

am.L: መልካም ማድረግን ተማሩ፤ ፍርድን ፈልጉ፤ ጨቋኙን አቅኑ፤ \q ለድሀ አደጉ ፍረዱ፤ ለመበለቲቱ ተሟገቱ።
am.B: መልካም ማድረግን ተማሩ። ፍትሕን ተከታተሉ። ጨቋኙን አስተካክሉ። \q ለድሀ አደጉ ልጅ ትክክለኛ ፍርድ ስጡ፤ በሸንጎ ለመበለቲቱ ቁሙላት።
am.R: መልካም የሆነውን ማድረግ ተማሩ። ነገሮች ትክክል እንዲሆኑ ትጉ። ሌሎችን የሚበድሉትን አስቁሙ። \q አባቶቻቸው የሞቱባቸውን ልጆች መብት አስከብሩ። መበለቶች ሲበደሉ ተናገሩላቸው።

hi.L: भलाई करना सीखो; न्याय की खोज करो; अत्याचारी को सुधारो; \q अनाथ का न्याय करो; विधवा का मुक़दमा लड़ो।
hi.B: भला करना सीखो। न्याय के पीछे लगो। अत्याचारी को सीधे रास्ते पर लाओ। \q अनाथ बच्चे का मामला ठीक से सुनो; अदालत में विधवा का पक्ष लो।
hi.R: जो भला है, वह करना सीखो। सबके साथ न्याय हो, इसके लिए मेहनत करो। जो दूसरों पर अत्याचार करते हैं, उन्हें रोको। \q जिन बच्चों के पिता मर चुके हैं, उनके अधिकारों की रक्षा करो। जब विधवाओं के साथ अन्याय हो, तब उनके पक्ष में बोलो।

ru.L: Научитесь делать добро; ищите справедливости; исправляйте притеснителя; \q защищайте сироту; ведите дело вдовы.
ru.B: Учитесь делать добро. Добивайтесь справедливости. Обуздайте притеснителя. \q Дайте сироте честный суд; заступайтесь в суде за вдову.
ru.R: Учитесь делать то, что хорошо. Старайтесь, чтобы всё было по справедливости. Останавливайте тех, кто обижает других. \q Защищайте права детей, у которых умер отец. Заступайтесь за вдов, когда с ними поступают несправедливо.

ja.L: 善を行うことを学べ。公正を求めよ。虐げる者を正せ。 \q みなしごのために裁け。やもめのために争え。
ja.B: 善を行うことを学びなさい。公正を追い求めなさい。虐げる者を正しなさい。 \q みなしごの訴えを正しく裁き、やもめのために法廷で弁護しなさい。
ja.R: よいことをするように学びなさい。公平な世の中になるように努めなさい。人をひどい目にあわせる者を止めなさい。 \q 父親のいない子どもたちの権利を守りなさい。不当な扱いを受けているやもめのために声を上げなさい。

decisions.choice: set right the oppressor: correct the one who crushes others
decisions.reason: The verb means to make go straight. The noun is read as "the oppressor", one who crushes others. With a small change in the vowels it would be "the oppressed", and the command would be to set the oppressed right, that is, to help them; the Septuagint reads it that way ("rescue the one wronged").

decisions.choice: the fatherless and the widow: those with no man to defend them in court
decisions.reason: In Israel a woman or child without a husband or father had no one to speak for them in court and could easily be cheated. God commands that they be protected and calls himself their defender (Exodus 22:21-23; Deuteronomy 10:18; 24:17).

decisions.choice: judge, plead: take up their legal case
decisions.reason: "Judge" here means to give someone their rights in court; "plead" means to take up their case as their advocate.

decisions.choice: fatherless child ... in court / children whose fathers have died
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly who the fatherless are and that these are legal cases.

decisions.choice: *mishpat*: "haki" here at every level
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "hukumu" at L for *mishpat*, but "tafuteni hukumu" would read as "seek a verdict"; the command is to pursue justice, so L too says "haki". Where *mishpat* means a ruling, L keeps "hukumu".

decisions.choice: "công lý" (justice)
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps "công lý" where the English has "justice" and "sự công chính" for "righteousness" (verses 21, 26, 27).

decisions.choice: "정의" for *mishpat*
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for justice (as Matthew 12:18); Readable describes it as making things fair.

decisions.choice: justice (mishpat) "ፍርድ" (L), "ፍትሕ" (B, R); the fatherless "ድሀ አደግ", the widow "መበለት"
decisions.reason: As the terms list and Deuteronomy on main. The verbs of verse 17 are courtroom words, so Balanced says "ትክክለኛ ፍርድ ስጡ" and "በሸንጎ ... ቁሙላት" as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: mishpat "justice": "公正" (L, B, and R where the English Readable says justice); Readable may say "公平" where the English Readable spells it out, as here. Its partner tsedeq / tsedaqah is "正義" (1:21, 1:26-27, 5:7, 5:16); the pair "公正と正義" is the book's (and the prophets') standing pair. mishpat as a verdict or a court case is "裁き".
decisions.reason: In the oracles of chapters 1-12 the pair names the right order God requires in the city (1:21, 5:7). "正義" keeps the social sense; "義", the NT word, can stand for God's saving righteousness later in the book, with a decision where it is used.

source.text: לְכוּ־נָ֛א וְנִוָּֽכְחָ֖ה יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אִם־יִֽהְי֨וּ חֲטָאֵיכֶ֤ם כַּשָּׁנִים֙ כַּשֶּׁ֣לֶג יַלְבִּ֔ינוּ אִם־יַאְדִּ֥ימוּ כַתּוֹלָ֖ע כַּצֶּ֥מֶר יִהְיֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Come please, and let us argue together, says Yahweh: if they are your sins like scarlet, like snow they will be white; if they are red like crimson, like wool they will be.

en.L: Come now, and let us argue [it] out together, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q Though your sins are like scarlet, like snow they will be white; \q though they are red like crimson, like wool they will become.
en.B: Come, let us take this matter to court together, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q Your sins may be scarlet, yet they will turn white as snow; \q though they are as red as crimson dye, they will be like undyed wool.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says: Come, let us settle this matter between us. \q Your sins are like cloth dyed bright red. But they will become white like snow. \q They are dark red, but they will become white like wool.

es.L: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} ahora, y discutamos [el caso] juntos, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Aunque {{plural_you:sus pecados|vuestros pecados}} sean como la grana, como la nieve quedarán blancos; \q aunque sean rojos como el carmesí, como la lana quedarán.
es.B: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, llevemos juntos este asunto al tribunal, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Aunque {{plural_you:sus pecados|vuestros pecados}} sean de color escarlata, se volverán blancos como la nieve; \q aunque sean rojos como el tinte carmesí, quedarán como la lana sin teñir.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, arreglemos este asunto entre nosotros. \q {{plural_you:Sus pecados|Vuestros pecados}} son como tela teñida de rojo vivo. Pero se volverán blancos como la nieve. \q Son de un rojo oscuro, pero se volverán blancos como la lana.

fr.L: Venez donc, et plaidons ensemble, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Si vos péchés sont comme l’écarlate, comme la neige ils deviendront blancs ; \q s’ils sont rouges comme le cramoisi, comme la laine ils deviendront.
fr.B: Venez, portons ensemble cette affaire devant le tribunal, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Vos péchés ont beau être écarlates, ils deviendront blancs comme la neige ; \q même s’ils sont rouges comme la teinture cramoisie, ils deviendront comme la laine non teinte.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : Venez, réglons cette affaire entre nous. \q Vos péchés sont comme un tissu teint en rouge vif. Mais ils deviendront blancs comme la neige. \q Ils sont rouge foncé, mais ils deviendront blancs comme la laine.

sw.L: Njooni basi, tusemezane, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: \q Ingawa dhambi zenu ni kama rangi nyekundu, zitakuwa nyeupe kama theluji; \q ingawa ni nyekundu iliyokolea, zitakuwa kama sufu.
sw.B: Njooni, tulipeleke shauri hili mahakamani pamoja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Dhambi zenu zaweza kuwa nyekundu sana, lakini zitakuwa nyeupe kama theluji; \q ingawa ni nyekundu iliyokolea kama rangi ya nguo za kifalme, zitakuwa kama sufu isiyotiwa rangi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema: Njooni, tulimalize jambo hili kati yetu. \q Dhambi zenu ni kama kitambaa kilichotiwa rangi nyekundu sana. Lakini zitakuwa nyeupe kama theluji. \q Ni nyekundu iliyokolea, lakini zitakuwa nyeupe kama sufu.

vi.L: Nào, hãy đến, chúng ta hãy cùng nhau tranh luận, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Dù tội các ngươi như màu đỏ điều, sẽ trắng như tuyết; \q dù đỏ như màu đỏ thẫm, sẽ trở nên như lông chiên.
vi.B: Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy cùng nhau phân xử, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. \q Dù tội các ngươi đỏ như điều, cũng sẽ trắng như tuyết; \q dù đỏ thắm như thuốc nhuộm đỏ thẫm, cũng sẽ như lông chiên chưa nhuộm.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy giải quyết việc này với nhau. \q Tội lỗi các ngươi như vải nhuộm đỏ chói. Nhưng chúng sẽ trở nên trắng như tuyết. \q Chúng đỏ thẫm, nhưng sẽ trở nên trắng như lông chiên.

ko.L: 자, 와서 우리 함께 따져 보자. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 너희 죄가 주홍색 같을지라도 눈같이 희어질 것이고, \q 진홍색같이 붉을지라도 양털같이 될 것이다.
ko.B: 와서 이 문제를 함께 법정에서 가리자. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 너희 죄가 주홍빛이라도 눈처럼 희어지고, \q 진홍 물감처럼 붉어도 물들이지 않은 양털처럼 될 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 자, 와서 우리 사이의 이 문제를 해결하자. \q 너희 죄는 새빨갛게 물들인 옷감 같다. 그러나 그것이 눈처럼 하얗게 될 것이다. \q 짙은 붉은색이라도 양털처럼 하얗게 될 것이다.

pt.L: Venham agora e debatamos [a questão] juntos, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q se os pecados de vocês forem como o escarlate, como a neve ficarão brancos; \q se forem vermelhos como o carmesim, ficarão como a lã.
pt.B: Venham, vamos levar esta causa ao tribunal, vocês e eu, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. \q Os seus pecados podem ser cor de escarlate, mas vão ficar brancos como a neve; \q ainda que sejam vermelhos como tinta carmesim, ficarão como lã sem tingir.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Venham, vamos resolver esta questão entre nós. \q Os pecados de vocês são como um pano tingido de vermelho vivo. Mas eles vão ficar brancos como a neve. \q São de um vermelho escuro, mas vão ficar brancos como a lã.

am.L: እስኪ ኑ፤ በአንድነት እንዋቀስ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ \q ኃጢአታችሁ እንደ ቀይ ግምጃ ቢሆን፣ እንደ በረዶ ነጭ ይሆናል፤ \q እንደ ደማቅ ቀይ ቢቀላም፣ እንደ ባዘቶ ይሆናል።
am.B: ኑ፤ ይህን ነገር በአንድነት ወደ ፍርድ እናቅርበው፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}። \q ኃጢአታችሁ እንደ ቀይ ቀለም ቢሆንም እንደ በረዶ ይነጣል፤ \q እንደ ደማቅ ቀይ ማቅለሚያ ቢቀላም፣ ያልተነከረ የበግ ጠጉር ይመስላል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ኑ፤ ይህን ነገር በመካከላችን እንጨርሰው። \q ኃጢአታችሁ በደማቅ ቀይ ቀለም እንደ ተነከረ ጨርቅ ነው። ነገር ግን እንደ በረዶ ነጭ ይሆናል። \q ጥቁር ቀይ ነው፤ ነገር ግን እንደ በግ ጠጉር ነጭ ይሆናል።

hi.L: अब आओ, हम मिलकर बहस कर लें, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं: \q चाहे तुम्हारे पाप लाल रंग जैसे हों, वे हिम जैसे सफ़ेद होंगे; \q चाहे वे किरमिज़ जैसे लाल हों, वे ऊन जैसे हो जाएँगे।
hi.B: आओ, हम इस मामले को साथ-साथ अदालत में ले चलें, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं। \q तुम्हारे पाप चाहे गहरे लाल हों, फिर भी वे बर्फ़ जैसे उजले हो जाएँगे; \q चाहे वे किरमिज़ी रंग जैसे लाल हों, वे बिना रंगे ऊन जैसे हो जाएँगे।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं: आओ, हम आपस में इस मामले को सुलझा लें। \q तुम्हारे पाप चटक लाल रंग में रंगे कपड़े जैसे हैं। पर वे बर्फ़ की तरह सफ़ेद हो जाएँगे। \q वे गहरे लाल हैं, पर वे ऊन की तरह सफ़ेद हो जाएँगे।

ru.L: Придите же, и давайте разберёмся вместе, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q если ваши грехи будут как алая краска, — как снег они побелеют; \q если они красны, как кармин, — шерстью станут.
ru.B: Придите, давайте разберём это дело вместе, говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}. \q Пусть ваши грехи алые — они станут белыми, как снег; \q пусть они красны, как кармин, — станут как некрашеная шерсть.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} говорит: Давайте решим это дело между собой. \q Ваши грехи как ткань, окрашенная в ярко-красный цвет. Но они станут белыми, как снег. \q Они тёмно-красные, но станут белыми, как шерсть.

ja.L: さあ、来て、論じ合おう、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q あなたがたの罪が緋のようであっても、雪のように白くなる。 \q 紅のように赤くても、羊の毛のようになる。
ja.B: さあ、来なさい。共に法廷で決着をつけよう、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q あなたがたの罪が緋色であっても、雪のように白くなる。 \q 紅の染料のように赤くても、染めていない羊の毛のようになる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言う。さあ、来なさい。わたしとあなたたちの間で、この問題に決着をつけよう。 \q あなたたちの罪は、真っ赤に染めた布のようだ。しかし、それは雪のように白くなる。 \q 濃い赤色でも、羊の毛のように白くなる。

decisions.choice: let us argue it out: settle the case at law
decisions.reason: The verb belongs to the law court: to present a case and reach a verdict (Micah 6:2; Job 23:7). It continues the lawsuit that began in verse 2. God summons Judah to settle the case with him.

decisions.choice: though ... they will be white: an offer of cleansing
alternatives: If your sins are like scarlet, can they be white as snow?
decisions.reason: Read with verses 19-20, the clauses are an offer: though their sins are deep red, God will make them white, if they are willing and obey. The words can also be read as a pointed question ("If your sins are like scarlet, can they become white as snow?"), meaning they cannot be cleansed while Judah goes on as it is.

decisions.choice: scarlet, crimson: deep red dyes
decisions.reason: Scarlet and crimson dye came from an insect and gave cloth a bright red that did not wash out. The contrast is with the white of snow and of wool before it is dyed (Psalm 51:9). Red may also recall the blood on their hands (verse 15).

decisions.choice: crimson dye ... undyed wool / cloth dyed bright red
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that the colors are dyes in cloth, which is what makes the picture work.

decisions.choice: "rangi nyekundu" for scarlet, "nyekundu iliyokolea" (deep red) for crimson
decisions.reason: Swahili has one basic word for red, so the two dyes (m3) are told apart as red and deep red; Balanced adds "kama rangi ya nguo za kifalme" to give the sense of a costly dye.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán" for "says the LORD" here
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here is "amar YHWH" (says), not the formula "neʾum YHWH", which the terms note renders "CHÚA phán vậy"; the plain verb keeps the two apart.

decisions.choice: debatamos [a questão] juntos (L); vamos levar esta causa ao tribunal (B)
decisions.reason: The verb belongs to the law court (m1), and the chapter is God's lawsuit with Judah, so Literal says "debater [a questão]" and Balanced names the court. The familiar renderings either sound archaic or turn the summons into a friendly talk, which loses the setting; Readable says "resolver esta questão entre nós", as the English Readable does.

source.text: אִם־תֹּאב֖וּ וּשְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם ט֥וּב הָאָ֖רֶץ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: If you are willing and you listen, [the] good of the land you will eat.

en.L: If you are willing and you listen, \q the good [things] of the land you will eat.
en.B: If you consent and listen to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q you will eat the rich produce of the land.
en.R: If you choose to obey {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q you will have plenty of good food from your land.

es.L: Si {{plural_you:quieren y escuchan|queréis y escucháis}}, \q lo bueno de la tierra {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}}.
es.B: Si {{plural_you:aceptan|aceptáis}} y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}}, \q {{plural_you:comerán|comeréis}} los ricos frutos de la tierra.
es.R: Si {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} de buena gana, \q {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} buena comida en abundancia de {{plural_you:su tierra|vuestra tierra}}.

fr.L: Si vous voulez et que vous écoutez, \q vous mangerez les bonnes [choses] du pays.
fr.B: Si vous acceptez de {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}écouter, \q vous mangerez les meilleurs produits du pays.
fr.R: Si vous choisissez de {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}obéir, \q vous aurez beaucoup de bonne nourriture de votre pays.

sw.L: Mkikubali na kusikiliza, \q mtakula mema ya nchi.
sw.B: Mkikubali na kunisikiliza, \q mtakula mazao bora ya nchi.
sw.R: Mkichagua kunitii, \q mtapata chakula kingi kizuri kutoka katika nchi yenu.

vi.L: Nếu các ngươi sẵn lòng và vâng nghe, \q các ngươi sẽ ăn những [vật] tốt của đất.
vi.B: Nếu các ngươi bằng lòng và vâng nghe {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q các ngươi sẽ được ăn hoa màu tốt nhất của xứ.
vi.R: Nếu các ngươi chọn vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q các ngươi sẽ có dư dật thức ăn ngon từ đất của mình.

ko.L: 너희가 기꺼이 하고 듣는다면, \q 너희는 땅의 좋은 [것을] 먹을 것이다.
ko.B: 너희가 기꺼이 내 말을 들으면, \q 땅에서 나는 좋은 소출을 먹을 것이다.
ko.R: 너희가 마음을 정하고 내 말에 순종하면, \q 너희 땅에서 나는 좋은 먹을거리를 넉넉히 얻을 것이다.

pt.L: Se vocês quiserem e ouvirem, \q o melhor da terra comerão.
pt.B: Se vocês aceitarem e {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} ouvirem, \q comerão os bons frutos da terra.
pt.R: Se vocês decidirem {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} obedecer, \q terão muita comida boa da sua terra.

am.L: ብትፈቅዱና ብትሰሙ፣ \q የምድሪቱን መልካም [ነገር] ትበላላችሁ።
am.B: ብትፈቅዱና ብትሰሙኝ፣ \q የምድሪቱን ምርጥ ፍሬ ትበላላችሁ።
am.R: ልትታዘዙኝ ብትመርጡ፣ \q ከምድራችሁ ብዙ መልካም ምግብ ታገኛላችሁ።

hi.L: यदि तुम राज़ी हो और सुनो, \q तो देश की अच्छी [वस्तुएँ] खाओगे।
hi.B: यदि तुम मान जाओ और मेरी सुनो, \q तो तुम देश की उत्तम उपज खाओगे।
hi.R: यदि तुम मेरी बात मानने का निर्णय करो, \q तो तुम्हें अपने देश से भरपूर अच्छा भोजन मिलेगा।

ru.L: Если захотите и послушаетесь, \q добро земли будете есть.
ru.B: Если согласитесь и послушаетесь {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, \q будете есть богатые плоды земли.
ru.R: Если вы решите слушаться {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, \q у вас будет много хорошей еды с вашей земли.

ja.L: もしあなたがたが進んで聞き従うなら、 \q あなたがたはこの地の良いものを食べる。
ja.B: あなたがたが同意して、わたしに聞き従うなら、 \q この地の豊かな実りを食べる。
