ja.R: あなたたちがわたしに従うことを選ぶなら、 \q 自分の土地から、良い食べ物をたくさん得られる。

decisions.choice: listen: obey
decisions.reason: To "listen" to God means to do what he says (Exodus 19:5; Deuteronomy 11:13).

decisions.choice: eat the good of the land: the blessing promised for obedience
decisions.reason: The Law promised the produce of the land to an obedient people and the sword to a rebellious one (Leviticus 26:3-8, 25; Deuteronomy 28:1-14). Verse 20 makes a play on "eat": eat the land's good, or be eaten by the sword.

decisions.choice: listen to me / obey me
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "me", God, who is speaking.

source.text: וְאִם־תְּמָאֲנ֖וּ וּמְרִיתֶ֑ם חֶ֣רֶב תְּאֻכְּל֔וּ כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And if you refuse and you rebel, [by the] sword you will be eaten; for [the] mouth of Yahweh has spoken.

en.L: But if you refuse and rebel, \q [by the] sword you will be eaten, \q for the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken.
en.B: But if you say no and rebel, \q the sword will eat you up; \q for the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken.
en.R: But if you refuse and turn against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q enemies will kill you in war. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} has said this.

es.L: Pero si {{plural_you:rehúsan y se rebelan|rehusáis y os rebeláis}}, \q [por la] espada {{plural_you:serán devorados|seréis devorados}}, \q porque la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ha hablado.
es.B: Pero si {{plural_you:dicen que no y se rebelan|decís que no y os rebeláis}}, \q la espada {{plural_you:los|os}} devorará; \q porque la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ha hablado.
es.R: Pero si {{plural_you:se niegan|os negáis}} y {{plural_you:se ponen|os ponéis}} en contra de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, \q los enemigos {{plural_you:los|os}} matarán en la guerra. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} mismo lo ha dicho.

fr.L: Mais si vous refusez et vous révoltez, \q [par] l’épée vous serez dévorés, \q car la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a parlé.
fr.B: Mais si vous refusez et vous révoltez, \q l’épée vous dévorera ; \q car la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a parlé.
fr.R: Mais si vous refusez et vous tournez contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, \q des ennemis vous tueront à la guerre. \q C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} qui l’a dit.

sw.L: Lakini mkikataa na kuasi, \q mtaliwa na upanga, \q kwa maana kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kimenena.
sw.B: Lakini mkikataa na kuasi, \q upanga utawala; \q kwa maana kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kimesema.
sw.R: Lakini mkikataa na kuniasi, \q maadui watawaua vitani. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} amesema hivi.

vi.L: Nhưng nếu các ngươi từ chối và phản nghịch, \q các ngươi sẽ bị gươm nuốt, \q vì miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.B: Nhưng nếu các ngươi khước từ và phản nghịch, \q gươm sẽ nuốt các ngươi; \q vì miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.R: Nhưng nếu các ngươi từ chối và chống lại {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q quân thù sẽ giết các ngươi trong chiến tranh. \q Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán điều này.

ko.L: 그러나 너희가 거절하고 반역하면, \q 너희가 칼에 먹힐 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 입이 말씀하셨기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 너희가 싫다 하고 거역하면, \q 칼이 너희를 삼킬 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 입으로 말씀하셨다.
ko.R: 그러나 너희가 거절하고 나에게 등을 돌리면, \q 적들이 전쟁에서 너희를 죽일 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 친히 이 말씀을 하셨다.

pt.L: Mas, se recusarem e se rebelarem, \q [pela] espada serão devorados, \q porque a boca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} falou.
pt.B: Mas, se disserem não e se rebelarem, \q a espada vai devorá-los; \q porque a boca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} falou.
pt.R: Mas, se recusarem e se voltarem contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, \q os inimigos vão matá-los na guerra. \q Quem disse isso foi {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

am.L: እምቢ ብትሉና ብታምፁ ግን፣ \q ሰይፍ ይበላችኋል፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} አፍ ተናግሯልና።
am.B: እምቢ ብትሉና ብታምፁ ግን፣ \q ሰይፍ ይበላችኋል፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} አፍ ተናግሯልና።
am.R: እምቢ ብትሉና በእኔ ላይ ብታምፁ ግን፣ \q ጠላቶች በጦርነት ይገድሏችኋል። \q ይህን የተናገረው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ራሱ ነው።

hi.L: पर यदि तुम इनकार करो और विद्रोह करो, \q तो तलवार [से] खाए जाओगे, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मुख ने कहा है।
hi.B: पर यदि तुम मना करो और विद्रोह करो, \q तो तलवार तुम्हें खा जाएगी; \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के मुख ने यह कहा है।
hi.R: पर यदि तुम इनकार करो और मेरे विरुद्ध हो जाओ, \q तो शत्रु युद्ध में तुम्हें मार डालेंगे। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने स्वयं यह कहा है।

ru.L: А если откажетесь и восстанете, \q мечом будете съедены, \q потому что уста {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} сказали.
ru.B: Но если откажетесь и восстанете, \q меч поглотит вас, \q потому что так сказали уста {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Но если вы откажетесь и восстанете против {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, \q враги убьют вас на войне. \q Это сказал сам {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: しかし、もしあなたがたが拒んで逆らうなら、 \q 剣に食われる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の口が語ったからだ。
ja.B: しかし、拒んで逆らうなら、 \q 剣があなたがたを食い尽くす。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の口が、こう語ったのだ。
ja.R: しかし、拒んでわたしに逆らうなら、 \q あなたたちは戦いで敵に殺される。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が自ら、こう言ったのだ。

decisions.choice: eaten by the sword: killed in war
decisions.reason: The sword is said to "eat" those it kills (Deuteronomy 32:42; 2 Samuel 2:26). It answers verse 19: if they obey they will eat; if they rebel they will be eaten.

decisions.choice: the mouth of Yahweh has spoken: the word is certain
decisions.reason: The phrase closes a word of God and seals it as sure to happen (40:5; 58:14; Micah 4:4).

decisions.choice: turn against me ... enemies will kill you in war
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one they rebel against and explains the sword as enemies in war.

decisions.choice: "the mouth of the LORD has spoken": "የ[[-]] አፍ ተናግሯልና" (L, B), "ይህን የተናገረው [[-]] ራሱ ነው" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula closes an oracle and recurs in Isaiah (40:5; 58:14); it keeps one wording through the book. Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: ki pi YHWH dibber "主の口が語ったからだ" (L), "主の口が、こう語ったのだ" (B), "主が自ら、こう言ったのだ" (R): plain, because God is speaking (1:18 "と主は言う").
alternatives: "主の口が語られた" (the prophet's seal, as 40:5)
decisions.reason: ki pi YHWH dibber / ki YHWH dibber inside God's own first-person speech takes the plain verb ("主の口が語った" L, B; "主が自ら、こう言った" R), as "と主は言う" (ISA-1: God uses no respect forms for himself); where the formula is the prophet's own seal on a word about God (24:3, 25:8, 40:5) it keeps the light respect form ("語られた").

source.text: אֵיכָה֙ הָיְתָ֣ה לְזוֹנָ֔ה קִרְיָ֖ה נֶאֱמָנָ֑ה מְלֵאֲתִ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֗ט צֶ֛דֶק יָלִ֥ין בָּ֖הּ וְעַתָּ֥ה מְרַצְּחִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: How she has become a prostitute, [the] town faithful, full of justice! Righteousness lodged in her, and now murderers.

en.L: How she has become a prostitute, the faithful town, \q [she who was] full of justice! Righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.
en.B: How the faithful town has turned prostitute! \q Justice filled her once; righteousness made its home in her. Now it is murderers.
en.R: How sad! Jerusalem used to be faithful to God, but now it is like a prostitute. \q It was full of justice, and righteousness lived there. But now murderers live there.

es.L: ¡Cómo se ha vuelto prostituta la ciudad fiel, \q [la que estaba] llena de derecho! La justicia moraba en ella, pero ahora, asesinos.
es.B: ¡Cómo se ha prostituido la ciudad fiel! \q Antes estaba llena de derecho; la justicia tenía en ella su hogar. Ahora, asesinos.
es.R: ¡Qué triste! Jerusalén antes era fiel a Dios, pero ahora es como una prostituta. \q Estaba llena de justicia, y allí vivía la rectitud. Pero ahora viven allí asesinos.

fr.L: Comment est-elle devenue une prostituée, la cité fidèle, \q [elle qui était] pleine de droit ! La justice y passait la nuit, et maintenant des meurtriers.
fr.B: Comment la cité fidèle est-elle devenue une prostituée ! \q Le droit la remplissait autrefois ; la justice y avait sa demeure. Maintenant, ce sont des meurtriers.
fr.R: Quelle tristesse ! Jérusalem était fidèle à Dieu, mais maintenant elle est comme une prostituée. \q Elle était pleine de justice, et le droit y habitait. Mais maintenant, ce sont des meurtriers qui y habitent.

sw.L: Jinsi alivyokuwa kahaba, mji mwaminifu, \q [ule uliokuwa] umejaa haki! Haki ilikaa ndani yake, lakini sasa wauaji.
sw.B: Jinsi mji mwaminifu ulivyogeuka kuwa kahaba! \q Zamani ulijaa haki; uadilifu ulikaa ndani yake. Sasa ni wauaji.
sw.R: Inasikitisha kama nini! Yerusalemu ulikuwa mwaminifu kwa Mungu, lakini sasa ni kama kahaba. \q Ulijaa haki, na uadilifu ulikaa humo. Lakini sasa wauaji wanaishi humo.

vi.L: Sao nó đã trở thành gái điếm, thành trung tín, \q [nó vốn] đầy công lý! Sự công chính đã cư ngụ trong nó, mà nay là những kẻ giết người.
vi.B: Than ôi, thành trung tín đã trở thành gái điếm! \q Xưa thành đầy công lý, sự công chính ở trong thành; nay toàn là kẻ giết người.
vi.R: Thật đáng buồn! Giê-ru-sa-lem xưa vốn trung tín với Đức Chúa Trời, nhưng nay như một gái điếm. \q Xưa thành đầy công lý, và sự công chính ngự ở đó. Nhưng nay những kẻ giết người lại ở đó.

ko.L: 어찌하여 신실하던 성읍이 창녀가 되었는가! \q 정의가 가득하던 [그 성읍]! 의가 그 안에 머물렀는데, 이제는 살인자들이 [있다].
ko.B: 신실하던 성읍이 어찌하여 창녀가 되었는가! \q 한때는 정의가 가득하고 의가 그 안에 깃들었는데, 이제는 살인자들이 산다.
ko.R: 슬프다! 예루살렘은 하나님께 신실한 성이었는데, 이제는 창녀처럼 되었다. \q 그 성에는 정의가 가득했고 옳은 일이 그곳에 머물렀다. 그러나 이제는 살인자들이 그곳에 산다.

pt.L: Como se tornou prostituta a cidade fiel, \q [ela que estava] cheia de justiça! A retidão pousava nela, mas agora, assassinos.
pt.B: Como a cidade fiel se prostituiu! \q A justiça a enchia antes; a retidão morava nela. Agora são os assassinos.
pt.R: Que tristeza! Jerusalém era fiel a Deus, mas agora é como uma prostituta. \q Era cheia de justiça, e lá as pessoas viviam do jeito certo. Mas agora quem mora lá são assassinos.

am.L: ታማኝ ከተማ እንዴት አመንዝራ ሆነች! \q ፍርድ የሞላባት [ነበረች]፤ ጽድቅ በእርሷ ያድር ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ነፍሰ ገዳዮች [አሉባት]።
am.B: ታማኟ ከተማ እንዴት አመንዝራ ሆነች! \q ቀድሞ ፍትሕ ሞልቶባት ነበር፤ ጽድቅም በውስጧ ይኖር ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ነፍሰ ገዳዮች ይኖሩባታል።
am.R: እንዴት ያሳዝናል! ኢየሩሳሌም ለእግዚአብሔር ታማኝ ነበረች፤ አሁን ግን እንደ አመንዝራ ሆናለች። \q ፍትሕ ሞልቶባት ነበር፤ ጽድቅም በእርሷ ይኖር ነበር። አሁን ግን ነፍሰ ገዳዮች ይኖሩባታል።

hi.L: कैसे वह वेश्या बन गई है, वह विश्वासयोग्य नगरी, \q [वह जो] न्याय से भरी थी! धार्मिकता उसमें बसती थी, पर अब हत्यारे।
hi.B: विश्वासयोग्य नगरी कैसे वेश्या बन गई! \q कभी वह न्याय से भरी थी; धार्मिकता उसमें बसती थी। अब वहाँ हत्यारे हैं।
hi.R: कितने दुख की बात है! यरूशलेम नगरी पहले परमेश्वर के प्रति विश्वासयोग्य थी, पर अब वह एक वेश्या के समान है। \q वह न्याय से भरी थी, और वहाँ धार्मिकता बसती थी। पर अब वहाँ हत्यारे रहते हैं।

ru.L: Как стал блудницей верный город, \q полный справедливости! Праведность ночевала в нём, а теперь — убийцы.
ru.B: Как верный город стал блудницей! \q Когда-то он был полон справедливости, праведность жила в нём. А теперь — убийцы.
ru.R: Как это печально! Иерусалим был верен Богу, а теперь он как блудница. \q В нём было полно справедливости, и там жила праведность. А теперь там живут убийцы.

ja.L: ああ、なんと遊女になってしまったことか、忠実だった町が！ \q 公正に満ちていた[町]、正義がそこに宿っていた。だが今は人殺したちが[いる]。
ja.B: ああ、忠実だった町が、なんと遊女になり果てたことか！ \q かつては公正に満ち、正義がそこに住んでいた。だが今は、人殺したちがいる。
ja.R: ああ、なんと悲しいことか！エルサレムは、かつては神に忠実だったのに、今では体を売る女のようだ。 \q かつては公正に満ち、正義がそこに住んでいた。しかし今では、人殺したちが住んでいる。

decisions.choice: how: a cry of lament
decisions.reason: The word opens a funeral song over something lost (Lamentations 1:1; 2:1; 2 Samuel 1:19). Verses 21-26 mourn the city before announcing its restoration.

decisions.choice: the faithful town has become a prostitute: Jerusalem unfaithful to God
decisions.reason: The prophets picture God's people as a wife and their unfaithfulness as prostitution (Hosea 2:4-7; Jeremiah 3:1-3; Ezekiel 16). Here the unfaithfulness is shown in injustice and murder rather than in worship of other gods.

decisions.choice: lodged: lived, made its home
decisions.reason: The verb means to spend the night or to stay. Righteousness once lived in the city; now murderers do.

decisions.choice: How sad! Jerusalem ... faithful to God ... like a prostitute
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the lament cry, names the city, says to whom it was faithful, and makes the picture a comparison.

decisions.choice: derecho ... la justicia (L, B)
decisions.reason: Where mishpat and tsedeq / tsedaqah stand together, mishpat is "derecho" and tsedeq "justicia" at Literal and Balanced, as published in Psalms 33:5, 89:15 and 97:2 (Literal) and used throughout Isaiah and Jeremiah. Readable says what is just and right in plain words.

decisions.choice: "haki" for *mishpat*, "uadilifu" for *tsedeq* when the two stand side by side
decisions.reason: Swahili "haki" covers both words; where the Hebrew pairs them, B and R say "uadilifu" for the second so the pair stays two words. L keeps "haki" for both, as the John table.

decisions.choice: "droit" for *mishpat*, "justice" for *tsedeq* (L, B)
decisions.reason: When the two words are paired, French says "le droit et la justice", as the terms note settles; Readable keeps both words in plain sentences.

decisions.choice: "Than ôi" (B); "Thật đáng buồn" (R) for the lament "how"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "ʾekah" opens a lament, not a question; Balanced and Readable use the terms note's words of lament, and Literal keeps "Sao".

decisions.choice: "의" (L, B) and "옳은 일" (R) for *tsedeq*
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for righteousness, kept the same throughout Isaiah.

decisions.choice: a justiça (mishpat); a retidão (tsedeq, tsedaqah) (L, B); R as the English
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the pair that runs through Isaiah (1:27; 5:7, 16; 9:7; 32:1 and after) keeps two words. Mishpat, what is just in court and in life, is "a justiça"; tsedeq and tsedaqah, what is right, are "a retidão" wherever the English says "righteousness". "O direito" now means law or a right and "juízo" sounds archaic. Where the English says "justice", "victory" or "deliverance" for tsedaqah, Portuguese follows its sense. Readable says it plainly ("viviam do jeito certo") where the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: prostitute (zonah) of the unfaithful city "አመንዝራ"
decisions.reason: Elsewhere a prostitute is "ዝሙት አዳሪ"; here the picture is a faithful wife turned unfaithful to God, which "አመንዝራ" (an adulterous, unfaithful woman) carries in Amharic.

decisions.choice: नगरी
decisions.reason: The town (qiryah) is a woman in this lament; नगरी, the feminine word for a city, keeps the feminine agreement (बन गई, भरी थी) that the picture of the unfaithful wife needs, and returns in 1:26.

decisions.choice: "верный город", masculine
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pictures the town as a woman ("she"). Russian "город" is masculine, so the pronouns that follow are masculine; "блудница" keeps the picture of the unfaithful wife.

decisions.choice: 'eikhah "How ...!": "ああ、なんと……ことか！" (L, B), "ああ、なんと悲しいことか！" (R), as Lamentations; zonah "遊女" (L, B), "体を売る女" (R), as Joshua-Kings and Proverbs.
decisions.reason: The lament cry has one form across Isaiah and Lamentations; the harlot image keeps the book-wide word for zonah, and Readable uses the everyday phrase.

source.text: כַּסְפֵּ֖ךְ הָיָ֣ה לְסִיגִ֑ים סָבְאֵ֖ךְ מָה֥וּל בַּמָּֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Your silver has become dross; your drink mixed with water.

en.L: Your silver has become dross; \q your drink [is] mixed with water.
en.B: Your silver has turned to slag; \q your wine is cut with water.
en.R: Jerusalem, you were like pure silver, but now you are like the waste left over when silver is melted. \q You were like good wine, but now you are like wine mixed with water.

es.L: Tu plata se ha vuelto escoria; \q tu bebida [está] mezclada con agua.
es.B: Tu plata se ha convertido en desecho; \q tu vino está rebajado con agua.
es.R: Jerusalén, eras como plata pura, pero ahora eres como la escoria que queda cuando se funde la plata. \q Eras como buen vino, pero ahora eres como vino mezclado con agua.

fr.L: Ton argent est devenu des scories ; \q ta boisson [est] coupée d’eau.
fr.B: Ton argent s’est changé en scories ; \q ton vin est coupé d’eau.
fr.R: Jérusalem, tu étais comme de l’argent pur, mais maintenant tu ressembles aux déchets qui restent quand on fond l’argent. \q Tu étais comme du bon vin, mais maintenant tu ressembles à du vin mêlé d’eau.

sw.L: Fedha yako imekuwa takataka ya madini; \q kinywaji chako [kimechanganywa] na maji.
sw.B: Fedha yako imegeuka kuwa mavi ya chuma; \q divai yako imechanganywa na maji.
sw.R: Yerusalemu, ulikuwa kama fedha safi, lakini sasa uko kama takataka inayobaki fedha inapoyeyushwa. \q Ulikuwa kama divai nzuri, lakini sasa uko kama divai iliyochanganywa na maji.

vi.L: Bạc của ngươi đã thành cặn bã; \q rượu của ngươi [bị] pha nước.
vi.B: Bạc của ngươi đã biến thành xỉ; \q rượu của ngươi đã bị pha nước.
vi.R: Hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem, ngươi vốn như bạc nguyên chất, nhưng nay ngươi như cặn bã còn lại khi nấu chảy bạc. \q Ngươi vốn như rượu ngon, nhưng nay ngươi như rượu pha nước.

ko.L: 너의 은은 찌꺼기가 되었고, \q 너의 술은 물이 섞였다.
ko.B: 너의 은은 쇠똥이 되었고, \q 너의 포도주에는 물이 섞였다.
ko.R: 예루살렘아, 너는 순수한 은 같았으나, 이제는 은을 녹일 때 나오는 찌꺼기 같다. \q 너는 좋은 포도주 같았으나, 이제는 물 탄 포도주 같다.

pt.L: A tua prata tornou-se escória; \q a tua bebida [está] misturada com água.
pt.B: A tua prata virou escória; \q o teu vinho foi diluído com água.
pt.R: Jerusalém, tu eras como prata pura, mas agora és como a sujeira que sobra quando a prata é derretida. \q Eras como vinho bom, mas agora és como vinho misturado com água.

am.L: ብርሽ ዝገት ሆነ፤ \q የወይን ጠጅሽ በውኃ የተቀላቀለ [ነው]።
am.B: ብርሽ ወደ ዝቃጭ ተለወጠ፤ \q የወይን ጠጅሽም በውኃ ተበረዘ።
am.R: ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፣ እንደ ንጹሕ ብር ነበርሽ፤ አሁን ግን ብር ሲቀልጥ እንደሚቀረው ዝቃጭ ሆነሻል። \q እንደ ጥሩ የወይን ጠጅ ነበርሽ፤ አሁን ግን በውኃ እንደ ተበረዘ የወይን ጠጅ ሆነሻል።

hi.L: तुम्हारी चाँदी मैल बन गई है; \q तुम्हारा पेय पानी से मिला हुआ [है]।
hi.B: तुम्हारी चाँदी धातु का मैल बन गई है; \q तुम्हारे दाखमधु में पानी मिला दिया गया है।
hi.R: हे यरूशलेम, तुम शुद्ध चाँदी के समान थीं, पर अब तुम उस मैल के समान हो जो चाँदी पिघलाने पर बच जाता है। \q तुम अच्छे दाखमधु के समान थीं, पर अब तुम पानी मिले दाखमधु के समान हो।

ru.L: Твоё серебро стало шлаком; \q твоё питьё смешано с водой.
ru.B: Твоё серебро превратилось в шлак; \q твоё вино разбавлено водой.
ru.R: Иерусалим, ты был как чистое серебро, а теперь ты как отходы, которые остаются, когда серебро плавят. \q Ты был как хорошее вино, а теперь ты как вино, разбавленное водой.

ja.L: あなたの銀はかすとなり、 \q あなたの酒は水で薄められている。
ja.B: あなたの銀は、かすに変わった。 \q あなたのぶどう酒は、水で薄められている。
ja.R: エルサレムよ、あなたは純粋な銀のようだったが、今は銀を溶かしたときに出るかすのようだ。 \q あなたは良いぶどう酒のようだったが、今は水で薄めたぶどう酒のようだ。

decisions.choice: dross: the waste skimmed off when silver is refined
decisions.reason: When silver ore is melted, the impurities rise and are taken off as worthless dross (Proverbs 25:4; Ezekiel 22:18-22). Verse 25 returns to the picture.

decisions.choice: drink: wine or beer
decisions.reason: The word means a strong drink, such as wine or beer (Hosea 4:18; Nahum 1:10). Wine thinned with water has lost its strength and value.

decisions.choice: silver and wine: the city itself, which has lost its worth
decisions.reason: The two pictures describe what Jerusalem has become, as verse 23 explains: what was valuable has become cheap. They may also hint at merchants who cheated with poor silver and watered wine.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem, you were like pure silver ... You were like good wine
decisions.reason: Readable names the city and makes both pictures comparisons. Balanced says "slag" and "wine"; Literal keeps "dross" and "drink".

decisions.choice: "ton argent ... ta boisson"
decisions.reason: The city is addressed in the feminine singular here, so French says "tu", as the terms note settles: Zion "tu", the people "vous".

decisions.choice: the city addressed in rebuke is "ngươi" at every level
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "con" (B, R) to Zion addressed as one person in the passages of comfort; here God rebukes the unfaithful city and announces judgment (verses 21-25), so "ngươi" is kept at every level through verse 26, as for the foreign cities.

decisions.choice: tu, teu, tua (God to Jerusalem, verses 22-26)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns to the city in the feminine singular. As God speaks to one person with "tu" in the Old Testament, he speaks to Jerusalem or Zion addressed as one with "tu" at every level, here and through the book; the people addressed as a group are "vocês" (verses 2-20, 29-31).

decisions.choice: dross "ዝቃጭ" (B, R), "ዝገት" (L)
decisions.reason: The waste skimmed off molten silver; "ዝቃጭ" (dregs, slag) says it plainly, and Literal's "ዝገት" (corrosion) keeps the sense of base metal. Verse 25 keeps the same word at each level.

decisions.choice: तुम to the city
decisions.reason: God speaks to Jerusalem, pictured as a woman, with तुम, as he addresses people throughout; Readable keeps the feminine agreement (थीं).

decisions.choice: The city addressed in the feminine singular ("your silver", 1:21-26) is "あなた" at every level, never "おまえ" or "彼女"; Readable names her (エルサレムよ) as the English Readable does.
decisions.reason: The singular address to the city follows the rule of 1:5 ("あなた" for God's own people); Japanese marks no gender, so the personified city needs no pronoun of its own.

source.text: שָׂרַ֣יִךְ סוֹרְרִ֗ים וְחַבְרֵי֙ גַּנָּבִ֔ים כֻּלּוֹ֙ אֹהֵ֣ב שֹׁ֔חַד וְרֹדֵ֖ף שַׁלְמֹנִ֑ים יָתוֹם֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁפֹּ֔טוּ וְרִ֥יב אַלְמָנָ֖ה לֹֽא־יָב֥וֹא אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Your princes [are] rebels and companions of thieves; all of it loves a bribe and pursues rewards; [the] fatherless not they judge, and [the] case of [the] widow not comes to them.

en.L: Your princes [are] rebels and companions of thieves; \q every one of them loves a bribe and chases after payoffs. \q The fatherless they do not defend, \q and the widow's case does not come before them.
en.B: Your leaders are in revolt and keep company with thieves. \q All of them love a bribe and go hunting for payoffs. \q The fatherless get no justice from them; \q the widow's lawsuit is never heard in their court.
en.R: Your leaders refuse to obey God. They are friends with thieves. \q They all love it when people pay them money to do wrong. They are always looking for gifts. \q They do not protect children who have no father. \q They will not even listen when a widow brings them her problem.

es.L: Tus príncipes [son] rebeldes y compañeros de ladrones; \q cada uno de ellos ama el soborno y corre tras las dádivas. \q Al huérfano no defienden, \q y la causa de la viuda no llega ante ellos.
es.B: Tus jefes andan en rebeldía y se juntan con ladrones. \q Todos aman el soborno y van a la caza de regalos. \q Al huérfano no le hacen justicia; \q el pleito de la viuda nunca se oye en su tribunal.
es.R: Tus líderes se niegan a obedecer a Dios. Son amigos de ladrones. \q A todos les encanta que la gente les pague para hacer el mal. Siempre andan buscando regalos. \q No protegen a los niños que no tienen padre. \q Ni siquiera escuchan cuando una viuda les presenta su problema.

fr.L: Tes princes [sont] des rebelles et des compagnons de voleurs ; \q chacun d’eux aime le pot-de-vin et court après les cadeaux. \q Ils ne font pas droit à l’orphelin, \q et la cause de la veuve ne parvient pas jusqu’à eux.
fr.B: Tes chefs sont en révolte et fréquentent les voleurs. \q Tous aiment les pots-de-vin et courent après les cadeaux. \q L’orphelin n’obtient d’eux aucune justice ; \q la plainte de la veuve n’arrive jamais à leur tribunal.
fr.R: Tes chefs refusent d’obéir à Dieu. Ils sont les amis des voleurs. \q Ils aiment tous qu’on leur paie de l’argent pour faire le mal. Ils cherchent toujours des cadeaux. \q Ils ne protègent pas les enfants qui n’ont plus de père. \q Ils n’écoutent même pas une veuve qui vient leur parler de son problème.

sw.L: Wakuu wako [ni] waasi na wenzi wa wezi; \q kila mmoja wao hupenda rushwa na kufuatia malipo. \q Yatima hawamtetei, \q wala shauri la mjane halifiki mbele yao.
sw.B: Viongozi wako ni waasi na hushirikiana na wezi. \q Wote hupenda rushwa na kuwinda malipo. \q Yatima hawapati haki kwao; \q kesi ya mjane haisikilizwi kamwe mahakamani mwao.
sw.R: Viongozi wako wanakataa kumtii Mungu. Wao ni marafiki wa wezi. \q Wote wanapenda watu wawalipe fedha ili watende mabaya. Daima wanatafuta zawadi. \q Hawawalindi watoto wasio na baba. \q Hawamsikilizi hata mjane anapowaletea shida yake.

vi.L: Các quan trưởng của ngươi [là] kẻ phản loạn và bạn bè của kẻ trộm; \q tất cả chúng đều ưa của hối lộ và chạy theo quà cáp; \q kẻ mồ côi chúng không xét xử, \q và vụ kiện của người góa bụa chẳng đến được với chúng.
vi.B: Các nhà lãnh đạo của ngươi là kẻ phản loạn, kết bạn với phường trộm cắp. \q Tất cả đều ham của hối lộ và săn lùng quà cáp. \q Trẻ mồ côi không được chúng xét xử công bằng; \q vụ kiện của người góa bụa không bao giờ được đưa ra trước tòa của chúng.
vi.R: Các nhà lãnh đạo của ngươi không chịu vâng phục Đức Chúa Trời. Họ là bạn bè của bọn trộm cắp. \q Họ đều thích được người ta đút tiền để làm điều sai trái. Họ luôn tìm kiếm quà cáp. \q Họ không bảo vệ những đứa trẻ không có cha. \q Họ cũng chẳng thèm nghe khi người góa bụa đến trình bày nỗi khổ của mình.

ko.L: 너의 고관들은 반역자들이고 도둑들의 친구들이다. \q 모두가 뇌물을 좋아하고 선물을 쫓아다닌다. \q 고아를 그들은 변호하지 않고, \q 과부의 송사는 그들에게 이르지 못한다.
ko.B: 너의 관리들은 반역하는 자들이요, 도둑과 한패다. \q 모두가 뇌물을 좋아하고 대가를 바라고 쫓아다닌다. \q 고아는 그들에게서 정당한 판결을 받지 못하고, \q 과부의 소송은 그들의 법정에서 다루어지지도 않는다.
ko.R: 너의 지도자들은 하나님께 순종하지 않는다. 그들은 도둑들과 친구로 지낸다. \q 그들은 모두 나쁜 일을 해 주고 돈 받기를 좋아한다. 늘 선물을 바란다. \q 그들은 아버지 없는 아이들을 보호하지 않는다. \q 과부가 억울한 일을 가지고 와도 들어 주지도 않는다.

pt.L: Os teus príncipes [são] rebeldes e companheiros de ladrões; \q cada um deles ama o suborno e corre atrás de recompensas. \q Ao órfão não fazem justiça, \q e a causa da viúva não chega até eles.
pt.B: Os teus líderes são rebeldes e andam com ladrões. \q Todos eles adoram suborno e vão à caça de propinas. \q O órfão não recebe justiça deles; \q a causa da viúva nunca é ouvida no tribunal deles.
pt.R: Os teus líderes se recusam a obedecer a Deus. São amigos de ladrões. \q Todos eles gostam quando alguém paga para eles fazerem o que é errado. Estão sempre atrás de presentes. \q Não protegem as crianças que não têm pai. \q Nem querem ouvir quando uma viúva vem contar o seu problema.

am.L: አለቆችሽ ዓመፀኞችና የሌቦች ባልንጀሮች [ናቸው]፤ \q ሁሉም ጉቦ ይወዳል፤ እጅ መንሻንም ይከተላል። \q ለድሀ አደጉ አይፈርዱም፤ \q የመበለቲቱም ጉዳይ ወደ እነርሱ አይደርስም።
am.B: መሪዎችሽ ዓመፀኞች ናቸው፤ ከሌቦችም ጋር ይወዳጃሉ። \q ሁሉም ጉቦ ይወዳሉ፤ ስጦታንም እያደኑ ይፈልጋሉ። \q ድሀ አደጉ ከእነርሱ ፍትሕ አያገኝም፤ \q የመበለቲቱም ክስ በሸንጎአቸው ፈጽሞ አይሰማም።
am.R: መሪዎችሽ እግዚአብሔርን አይታዘዙም። የሌቦች ጓደኞች ናቸው። \q ሁሉም ክፉ እንዲያደርጉ ሰዎች ገንዘብ ሲከፍሏቸው ደስ ይላቸዋል። ዘወትር ስጦታ ይፈልጋሉ። \q አባት የሌላቸውን ልጆች አይጠብቁም። \q መበለት ችግሯን ይዛ ስትመጣ እንኳ አያዳምጧትም።

hi.L: तुम्हारे हाकिम विद्रोही [हैं] और चोरों के साथी; \q उनमें से हर एक घूस से प्रेम करता है और भेंटों के पीछे भागता है। \q वे अनाथ का न्याय नहीं करते, \q और विधवा का मुक़दमा उनके सामने नहीं आता।
hi.B: तुम्हारे अगुवे विद्रोही हैं और चोरों की संगति करते हैं। \q वे सब घूस से प्रेम करते हैं और नज़रानों की खोज में रहते हैं। \q अनाथों को उनसे न्याय नहीं मिलता; \q विधवा का मुक़दमा उनकी अदालत में कभी सुना नहीं जाता।
hi.R: तुम्हारे अगुवे परमेश्वर की बात मानने से इनकार करते हैं। वे चोरों के मित्र हैं। \q जब लोग उन्हें ग़लत काम करने के लिए पैसे देते हैं, तो वे सब इससे ख़ुश होते हैं। वे हमेशा तोहफ़ों की ताक में रहते हैं। \q वे उन बच्चों की रक्षा नहीं करते जिनका कोई पिता नहीं। \q जब कोई विधवा अपनी समस्या लेकर उनके पास आती है, तो वे सुनते तक नहीं।

ru.L: Твои князья — мятежники и сообщники воров; \q каждый из них любит взятку и гонится за подачками. \q Сироту они не защищают, \q и дело вдовы не доходит до них.
ru.B: Твои правители бунтуют и водятся с ворами. \q Все они любят взятки и охотятся за подарками. \q Сироте от них нет правосудия; \q иск вдовы у них никогда не слушается.
ru.R: Твои правители не хотят слушаться Бога. Они дружат с ворами. \q Они все любят, когда им платят деньги, чтобы они сделали что-то плохое. Они всегда ищут подарков. \q Они не защищают детей, у которых нет отца. \q Они даже не слушают вдову, когда она приходит к ним со своей бедой.

ja.L: あなたの長たちは反逆者、盗人の仲間。 \q だれもが賄賂を愛し、報酬を追い求める。 \q みなしごのために裁かず、 \q やもめの訴えは彼らのもとに届かない。
ja.B: あなたの高官たちは逆らう者となり、盗人と仲間になっている。 \q 皆、賄賂を好み、見返りを追い求める。 \q みなしごは彼らから正しい裁きを受けられず、 \q やもめの訴えは、彼らの法廷で取り上げられることがない。
ja.R: あなたの指導者たちは、神に従おうとしない。泥棒の仲間になっている。 \q だれもが、悪いことをするために払われるお金が大好きで、いつも贈り物を欲しがっている。 \q 父親のいない子どもたちを守らない。 \q やもめが困りごとを訴えても、聞こうともしない。

decisions.choice: your princes are rebels: a play on sound
decisions.reason: The words for "princes" and "rebels" sound alike (sarayikh sorerim), as in Hosea 9:15. The leaders who should keep order are themselves stubborn rebels against God.

decisions.choice: bribe, rewards: payments to judges for a favorable verdict
decisions.reason: The Law forbade judges to take a bribe, because it blinds the eyes of the wise (Exodus 23:8; Deuteronomy 16:19). The word for "rewards" is found only here; it means payments or gifts.

decisions.choice: the widow's case does not come to them: they will not hear it
decisions.reason: The widow's lawsuit never reaches the judges, either because they refuse to hear it or because she has nothing to pay them. Compare verse 17, where these are the very cases they are to take up.

decisions.choice: refuse to obey God ... pay them money to do wrong
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one they rebel against and explains what a bribe is.

decisions.choice: हाकिम (L); अगुवे (B, R)
decisions.reason: Israel's sarim are the city's officials and leaders, not the king's sons: हाकिम at Literal and अगुवे at Balanced and Readable, as the Ezra pass has them.

decisions.choice: "князья" (L); "правители" (B, R) for the sarim
decisions.reason: The city's ruling officials, as in Ezra: "князья" keeps the Literal word; Balanced and Readable say what they were, rulers and judges of Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: sarim "princes, officials": "長たち" (L), "高官たち" (B), "指導者たち" (R), as 1 Chronicles. The sound-play sarayikh sorerim (m1) is not imitated.
alternatives: "指導者たち" at Balanced as the English
decisions.reason: One set of words for sarim across the historical books and the prophets; Japanese has no natural pun on the pair, and the meaning decision records it.

source.text: לָכֵ֗ן נְאֻ֤ם הָֽאָדוֹן֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲבִ֖יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ה֚וֹי אֶנָּחֵ֣ם מִצָּרַ֔י וְאִנָּקְמָ֖ה מֵאוֹיְבָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore, [the] declaration of the Lord GOD of hosts, [the] Mighty One of Israel: Woe! I will relieve myself of my foes, and I will avenge myself on my enemies.

en.L: Therefore, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel: \q Woe! I will get relief from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} adversaries, \q and I will avenge {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} enemies.
en.B: So the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, declares: \q Woe to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} foes! I will be rid of them at last; \q I will pay back {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} enemies.
en.R: So the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: \q How terrible it will be for {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} enemies! I will be rid of them. \q I will punish those who are against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Por tanto, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, el Poderoso de Israel: \q ¡Ay! Tomaré alivio de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} adversarios, \q y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} vengaré de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} enemigos.
es.B: Por eso afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Poderoso de Israel: \q ¡Ay de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} adversarios! Por fin me libraré de ellos; \q daré su merecido a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} enemigos.
es.R: Por eso dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, el Poderoso de Israel: \q ¡Qué terrible será para {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} enemigos! Me libraré de ellos. \q Castigaré a los que están en contra de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées, le Puissant d’Israël : \q Malheur ! Je me soulagerai de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} adversaires, \q et je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} vengerai de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} ennemis.
fr.B: C’est pourquoi le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées, le Puissant d’Israël, déclare : \q Malheur à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} adversaires ! J’en serai enfin débarrassé ; \q je ferai payer {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} ennemis.
fr.R: Alors le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} des armées, le Dieu puissant d’Israël, dit : \q Quel malheur pour {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} ennemis ! Je vais me débarrasser d’eux. \q Je punirai ceux qui sont contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mwenye Nguvu wa Israeli: \q Ole! Nitajipumzisha kwa watesi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q nami nitajilipizia kisasi juu ya adui {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.
sw.B: Basi Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mwenye Nguvu wa Israeli, asema: \q Ole wao watesi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}! Hatimaye nitaondokana nao; \q nitawalipa adui {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, Mwenye Nguvu wa Israeli, anasema: \q Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa adui {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}! Nitaondokana nao. \q Nitawaadhibu wale wanaonipinga.

vi.L: Vì vậy, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đấng Quyền Năng của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán vậy: \q Ôi! Ta sẽ trút bỏ các kẻ cừu địch của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và Ta sẽ báo trả các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Vì thế, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đấng Quyền Năng của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán vậy: \q Khốn cho các kẻ cừu địch của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! Cuối cùng Ta sẽ dứt bỏ chúng; \q Ta sẽ báo trả các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Vì thế, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đấng Quyền Năng của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán: \q Thật khốn khổ cho những kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}! Ta sẽ dứt bỏ chúng. \q Ta sẽ trừng phạt những kẻ chống nghịch {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그러므로 만군의 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 전능하신 분의 선언이다. \q 아! 내가 내 대적들에게서 마음을 풀고, \q 내 원수들에게 원수를 갚겠다.
ko.B: 그러므로 만군의 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 전능하신 분이 말한다. \q 내 대적들에게 화가 있다! 이제 내가 그들에게서 놓여나겠다. \q 내가 내 원수들에게 갚아 주겠다.
ko.R: 그래서 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}, 이스라엘의 전능하신 분이 말한다. \q 내 원수들에게 끔찍한 일이 닥칠 것이다! 내가 그들을 없애 버리겠다. \q 나를 대적하는 자들을 내가 벌하겠다.

pt.L: Por isso, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Poderoso de Israel: \q Ai! Vou aliviar-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} adversários \q e vingar-{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} inimigos.
pt.B: Por isso o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Poderoso de Israel, declara: \q Ai dos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} adversários! Enfim ficarei livre deles; \q farei os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} inimigos pagarem.
pt.R: Por isso o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} dos Exércitos, o Poderoso de Israel, diz: \q Que desgraça vai cair sobre os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} inimigos! Vou {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} livrar deles. \q Vou castigar os que estão contra {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

am.L: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል ኃያል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጸባኦት እንዲህ ይላል፦ \q ወዮ! ከባላጋራዎቼ ዕረፍት አገኛለሁ፤ \q ጠላቶቼንም እበቀላለሁ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ጌታ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ የእስራኤል ኃያል እንዲህ ይላል፦ \q ለባላጋራዎቼ ወዮላቸው! በመጨረሻ ከእነርሱ እገላገላለሁ፤ \q ጠላቶቼንም እበቀላለሁ።
am.R: ስለዚህ ጌታ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ የእስራኤል ኃያል እንዲህ ይላል፦ \q ለጠላቶቼ ወዮላቸው! ከእነርሱ እገላገላለሁ። \q የሚቃወሙኝንም እቀጣለሁ።

hi.L: इसलिए प्रभु, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के सामर्थी की यह वाणी है: \q हाय! मैं अपने विरोधियों से छुटकारा पाऊँगा, \q और अपने शत्रुओं से अपना पलटा लूँगा।
hi.B: इसलिए प्रभु, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के सामर्थी की यह वाणी है: \q हाय मेरे बैरियों पर! आख़िरकार मैं उनसे छुटकारा पाऊँगा; \q मैं अपने शत्रुओं से बदला लूँगा।
hi.R: इसलिए प्रभु, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}, इस्राएल के सामर्थी कहते हैं: \q मेरे शत्रुओं के लिए कितना भयानक होगा! मैं उनसे छुटकारा पा लूँगा। \q जो मेरे विरुद्ध हैं, उन्हें मैं दंड दूँगा।

ru.L: Поэтому — слово Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} Саваофа, Сильного Израиля: \q Горе! Я избавлюсь от {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} противников \q и отомщу за себя {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} врагам.
ru.B: Поэтому говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Саваоф, Сильный Израиля: \q Горе {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} противникам! Наконец {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} избавлюсь от них; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} воздам {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} врагам.
ru.R: Поэтому Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Воинств, Сильный Израиля, говорит: \q Беда ждёт {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} врагов! Я избавлюсь от них. \q Я накажу тех, кто против {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}.

ja.L: それゆえ、万軍の{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの力ある方の言葉。 \q ああ、わたしは仇から解き放たれて安らぎ、 \q わたしの敵に報復する。
ja.B: それゆえ、万軍の{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの力ある方は、こう告げる。 \q 災いだ、わたしの仇は！わたしはついに彼らから解き放たれる。 \q わたしは敵に報いを返す。
ja.R: そこで、天の軍勢を率いる{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}、イスラエルの力強い方は、こう言う。 \q わたしの敵は、なんとひどい目にあうことか！わたしは、もう彼らを我慢しない。 \q わたしに逆らう者たちを罰する。

decisions.choice: my foes, my enemies: the wicked within Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The enemies God will deal with are not a foreign army but the corrupt leaders and murderers of Jerusalem (verses 21-23). By their injustice God's own people have made themselves his enemies. The judgment that follows is a refining (verses 25-26).

decisions.choice: the Mighty One of Israel: the God who is Israel's strength
decisions.reason: The title echoes "the Mighty One of Jacob" (Genesis 49:24; Psalm 132:2, 5; Isaiah 49:26; 60:16). Only here is it "of Israel". It stands beside "Yahweh of hosts" to stress God's power.

decisions.choice: woe ... I will relieve myself: God's patience with evil comes to an end
decisions.reason: The same cry as in verse 4. The verb means to be comforted or eased: God will find relief from the wrong that has burdened him (verse 14).

decisions.choice: the Lord GOD of hosts / of Armies
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "the Lord" followed by God's name. Where the name follows "Lord" it is printed "GOD", as elsewhere, to avoid "the Lord LORD". Balanced and Readable say "Armies" (see 1:9).

decisions.choice: Woe to my foes / How terrible it will be for my enemies
decisions.reason: The cry "woe" stands alone in the Hebrew. Balanced and Readable join it to the enemies it is aimed at.

decisions.choice: declara (L); afirma (B); dice (R) ... el Señor DIOS
decisions.reason: Ne'um YHWH is "declara" at L, "afirma" at B and "dice" at R, as the terms note sets it from 1 Samuel 2:30 and 2 Kings 22:19. Adonai YHWH is "el Señor DIOS" (the setting gives "el Señor Yahvé"). Book-wide choice, recorded once for chapters 1-20.

decisions.choice: el Poderoso de Israel
decisions.reason: The title echoes "el Poderoso de Jacob" (Genesis 49:24; Psalm 132:2), and the terms note keeps the same word here.

decisions.choice: "Bwana MUNGU wa majeshi, Mwenye Nguvu wa Israeli"
decisions.reason: The title follows the terms note for 1:24; "Bwana MUNGU" renders Adonai YHWH, as in Samuel.

decisions.choice: "déclare" (L, B); "dit" (R)
decisions.reason: *neʾum* is "déclare" at Literal and Balanced, "dit" at Readable, as 2 Kings 19:33, for the whole book; with Adonai, "le Seigneur DIEU".

decisions.choice: "le Puissant d’Israël" (L, B); "le Dieu puissant d’Israël" (R)
decisions.reason: As "le Puissant de Jacob" in Psalm 132:2; Readable names him as God.

decisions.choice: "Chúa là CHÚA Vạn Quân, Đấng Quyền Năng của Y-sơ-ra-ên, phán vậy"
decisions.reason: "Chúa là CHÚA" is the terms note's form for "the Lord GOD"; the terms note keeps "Đấng Quyền Năng của Y-sơ-ra-ên" here because the Hebrew says Israel, not Jacob; "phán vậy" marks the formula "neʾum", as the note gives it.

decisions.choice: "만군의 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}" for "the Lord GOD of hosts"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form (Psalm 69:7 B): with *Adonai* before the name, the default reads "하나님" so that it does not say "주 주".

decisions.choice: "이스라엘의 전능하신 분" with "말한다" (B, R) for the declaration formula
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for 1:24 and for *ne'um*: the titles keep the honorific, while the formula "말한다" is the oracle's own (Literal "...의 선언이다").

decisions.choice: declara (L, B), diz (R); o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos; o Poderoso de Israel
decisions.reason: For the whole book: ne'um, the formula that seals a word as God's, is "declara" at Literal and Balanced and "diz" at Readable, as the English. "The Lord" with God's name after it is "o Senhor DEUS", as the Old Testament terms set it, so that the default never reads "o Senhor SENHOR"; with tseba'ot it takes "dos Exércitos" (1:9). The title of m2 is "o Poderoso de Israel", and "o Poderoso de Jacó" where Jacob is named (49:26; 60:16).

decisions.choice: the Lord (ha-adon) YHWH of hosts "ጌታ [[-]] ጸባኦት" (L), "ጌታ፣ የሠራዊት አምላክ [[-]]" (B, R); the Mighty One of Israel "የእስራኤል ኃያል", as "the Mighty One of Jacob" in Genesis 49:24
decisions.reason: Only the name goes inside the setting span; "ጌታ" is the title before it, as Adonai YHWH elsewhere. "declares" (neʾum) here comes before the words, so it is "እንዲህ ይላል፦" at every level.

decisions.choice: ... की यह वाणी है (L, B); ... कहते हैं (R); प्रभु, सेनाओं के {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}}
decisions.reason: The formula neum ("declares") is की यह वाणी है at L and B and कहते हैं at R, one wording for the whole book as the terms note sets it. "The Lord GOD of hosts" is प्रभु, सेनाओं के परमेश्वर with the name in the divine_name span, as Psalm 69:6, so that प्रभु is not said twice.

decisions.choice: इस्राएल का सामर्थी
decisions.reason: "The Mighty One of Israel" follows the form the Psalms and Genesis 49:24 use for "the Mighty One of Jacob" (याकूब का सामर्थी).

decisions.choice: "— слово Владыки ГОСПОДА Саваофа" (L); "говорит Владыка ГОСПОДЬ Саваоф / Воинств" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The formula neum ("declaration of") is "— слово ГОСПОДА" at Literal and "говорит ГОСПОДЬ" at Balanced and Readable, one wording through the Prophets. "The Lord GOD" (Adonai followed by the name) is "Владыка ГОСПОДЬ", as in Psalms, with the title of hosts after it.

decisions.choice: "Сильный Израиля" for the Mighty One of Israel
decisions.reason: Built like "Святой Израиля", Isaiah's other title for God, with the modern genitive. The Mighty One of Jacob (49:26; 60:16) is built the same way, "Сильный Иакова", where Genesis 49:24 and Psalm 132 have the older "Сильный Иаковлев".

decisions.choice: ne'um YHWH "declares the LORD": after or inside an oracle "――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉――" (L), "と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる" (B), "と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う" (R), as 2 Kings 19:33; at the head of an oracle, as here, "Xの言葉。" (L), "Xは、こう告げる。" (B), "Xは、こう言う。" (R). The formula stays plain, as God's own signature on the word.
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is a noun, "utterance of"; Literal keeps it as a noun phrase set off from the verse, and Balanced uses a verb kept apart from 'amar ("言う"). One form for every prophet.

decisions.choice: ha'adon / 'adonai YHWH (tseva'ot) "the Lord GOD (of hosts)": "{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}", with "万軍の" before it (L, B) or "天の軍勢を率いる" (R); 'avir Yisra'el "イスラエルの力ある方" (L, B), "イスラエルの力強い方" (R); tsar "仇" (L, B), 'oyev "敵".
decisions.reason: Japanese cannot set "Lord" beside "LORD" without a doubled 主; the span carries the divine name as the reader setting (主ヤハウェ), and the title "Mighty One" stays personal with "方".

source.text: וְאָשִׁ֤יבָה יָדִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְאֶצְרֹ֥ף כַּבֹּ֖ר סִיגָ֑יִךְ וְאָסִ֖ירָה כָּל־בְּדִילָֽיִךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will turn my hand against you, and I will smelt like lye your dross, and I will remove all your alloy.

en.L: And I will turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against you, \q and I will smelt away your dross as with lye, \q and I will remove all your alloy.
en.B: I will turn {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand against you; \q I will melt away your slag as with lye and clear out all your impure metal.
en.R: I will use {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} power against you. \q I will purify you, the way silver is melted down and cleaned. \q I will take away everything worthless in you.

es.L: Y volveré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra ti, \q y fundiré tu escoria como con lejía, \q y quitaré toda tu aleación.
es.B: Volveré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano contra ti; \q fundiré tu escoria como con lejía y quitaré todo tu metal impuro.
es.R: Usaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} poder contra ti. \q Te purificaré, como cuando se funde y se limpia la plata. \q Quitaré de ti todo lo que no vale nada.

fr.L: Et je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre toi, \q et je fondrai tes scories comme avec de la potasse, \q et j’ôterai tout ton alliage.
fr.B: Je tournerai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main contre toi ; \q je fondrai tes scories comme avec de la potasse et j’enlèverai tout ton métal impur.
fr.R: J’utiliserai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} puissance contre toi. \q Je te purifierai comme on fond l’argent pour le nettoyer. \q J’enlèverai tout ce qui n’a pas de valeur en toi.

sw.L: Nami nitaugeuza mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu yako, \q nami nitayeyusha takataka zako kama kwa magadi, \q nami nitaondoa madini yako yote hafifu.
sw.B: Nitaugeuza mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} dhidi yako; \q nitayeyusha takataka zako kama kwa magadi na kuondoa madini yako yote yasiyo safi.
sw.R: Nitatumia nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} dhidi yako. \q Nitakutakasa, kama fedha inavyoyeyushwa na kusafishwa. \q Nitaondoa kila kitu kisicho na thamani ndani yako.

vi.L: Ta sẽ trở tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nghịch cùng ngươi, \q Ta sẽ luyện sạch cặn bã của ngươi như bằng thuốc tẩy, \q và Ta sẽ loại bỏ hết mọi tạp chất của ngươi.
vi.B: Ta sẽ trở tay nghịch lại ngươi; \q Ta sẽ nấu chảy cặn bã của ngươi như dùng thuốc tẩy, và loại bỏ mọi kim loại tạp của ngươi.
vi.R: Ta sẽ dùng quyền năng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chống lại ngươi. \q Ta sẽ tinh luyện ngươi, như người ta nấu chảy bạc và làm cho sạch. \q Ta sẽ lấy đi mọi thứ vô giá trị trong ngươi.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 내 손을 너에게 돌려, \q 잿물로 씻듯이 너의 찌꺼기를 녹여 없애고, \q 너의 모든 불순물을 제거하겠다.
ko.B: 내가 손을 들어 너를 치고, \q 잿물로 씻어 내듯 너의 쇠똥을 녹여 없애고 섞인 불순물을 모두 걸러 내겠다.
ko.R: 내가 내 힘을 써서 너를 치겠다. \q 은을 녹여서 깨끗하게 하듯이 내가 너를 깨끗하게 하겠다. \q 너에게 있는 쓸모없는 것을 모두 없애겠다.

pt.L: E voltarei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão contra ti, \q e refinarei como com lixívia a tua escória, \q e removerei toda a tua liga.
pt.B: Voltarei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} mão contra ti; \q derreterei a tua escória como com lixívia e tirarei todo o metal impuro que há em ti.
pt.R: Usarei o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} poder contra ti. \q Vou te purificar, como a prata é derretida e limpa. \q Vou tirar tudo o que não presta em ti.

am.L: እጄንም በአንቺ ላይ እመልሳለሁ፤ \q ዝገትሽንም በእንዶድ እንደሚሆን አቀልጣለሁ፤ \q ቆርቆሮሽንም ሁሉ አስወግዳለሁ።
am.B: እጄን በአንቺ ላይ አዞራለሁ፤ \q ዝቃጭሽን በእንዶድ እንደሚቀለጥ አቀልጠዋለሁ፤ ርኩስ ብረትሽንም ሁሉ አስወግዳለሁ።
am.R: ኃይሌን በአንቺ ላይ እጠቀማለሁ። \q ብር ቀልጦ እንደሚጸዳ አነጻሻለሁ። \q ዋጋ የሌለውን ነገር ሁሉ ከአንቺ አስወግዳለሁ።

hi.L: और मैं अपना हाथ तुम्हारे विरुद्ध फेरूँगा, \q और तुम्हारे मैल को मानो सज्जी से गलाकर दूर करूँगा, \q और तुम्हारा सारा खोट निकाल दूँगा।
hi.B: मैं अपना हाथ तुम्हारे विरुद्ध उठाऊँगा; \q मैं तुम्हारे मैल को मानो सज्जी से गला दूँगा और तुम्हारी सारी खोट निकाल दूँगा।
hi.R: मैं अपनी शक्ति तुम्हारे विरुद्ध काम में लाऊँगा। \q मैं तुम्हें शुद्ध करूँगा, जैसे चाँदी को पिघलाकर साफ़ किया जाता है। \q मैं तुममें से हर निकम्मी चीज़ दूर कर दूँगा।

ru.L: И обращу {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} руку на тебя, \q и выплавлю, как щёлоком, твой шлак, \q и удалю всю твою примесь.
ru.B: Я обращу свою руку против тебя; \q выплавлю твой шлак, как щёлоком, и удалю весь твой нечистый металл.
ru.R: Я обращу против тебя свою силу. \q Я очищу тебя, как плавят и очищают серебро. \q Я уберу из тебя всё негодное.

ja.L: わたしはあなたの上にわたしの手を返し、 \q 灰汁で[溶かすように]あなたのかすを精錬し、 \q あなたの混ぜ物をすべて取り除く。
ja.B: わたしはあなたに手を向け、 \q 灰汁で溶かすように、あなたのかすを溶かし去り、混ざった不純な金属をすべて取り除く。
ja.R: わたしは、自分の力をあなたに向ける。 \q 銀を溶かしてきれいにするように、あなたを清める。 \q あなたの中の価値のないものを、すべて取り除く。

decisions.choice: turn my hand against you: act against you
decisions.reason: To turn the hand against someone is to strike them (Amos 1:8; Psalm 81:15). Here the blow is meant to purify, not to destroy.

decisions.choice: smelt as with lye: refine silver with a flux
alternatives: I will smelt your dross in the furnace
decisions.reason: Lye or potash was added to molten metal as a flux, to draw out the impurities. With a small change the word would read "in the furnace". Either way the picture is of silver being refined (48:10; Malachi 3:2-3).

decisions.choice: alloy: base metal mixed with the silver
decisions.reason: The word is used of tin or lead, cheaper metals mixed into the silver that must be removed (Ezekiel 22:18, 20). It answers verse 22: "your silver has become dross".

decisions.choice: use my power ... the way silver is melted down and cleaned
decisions.reason: Readable explains the hand as power and turns the refining into a comparison.

decisions.choice: lye "እንዶድ"; alloy "ቆርቆሮ" (L, tin), "ርኩስ ብረት" (B, impure metal)
decisions.reason: "እንዶድ" is the Ethiopian soapberry used for washing, the familiar cleansing agent; it stands for the alkali flux of the Hebrew. The verse addresses the city as feminine, as verses 21-26 do in Hebrew.

source.text: וְאָשִׁ֤יבָה שֹׁפְטַ֨יִךְ֙ כְּבָרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה וְיֹעֲצַ֖יִךְ כְּבַתְּחִלָּ֑ה אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן יִקָּ֤רֵא לָךְ֙ עִ֣יר הַצֶּ֔דֶק קִרְיָ֖ה נֶאֱמָנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning; after thus you will be called City of Righteousness, Town Faithful.

en.L: And I will restore your judges as at the first, \q and your counselors as at the beginning. \q After this you will be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful Town.
en.B: I will give you back judges like those you had at first, \q and counselors like those at the start. \q Then you will be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful Town.
en.R: I will give you good judges and wise advisers again, like the ones you had long ago. \q Then you will be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful Town.

es.L: Y restauraré tus jueces como al principio, \q y tus consejeros como al comienzo. \q Después de esto serás llamada Ciudad de Justicia, Ciudad Fiel.
es.B: Te devolveré jueces como los que tenías al principio, \q y consejeros como los del comienzo. \q Entonces te llamarán Ciudad de Justicia, Ciudad Fiel.
es.R: Te daré otra vez buenos jueces y consejeros sabios, como los que tenías hace mucho tiempo. \q Entonces te llamarán Ciudad de Justicia, Ciudad Fiel.

fr.L: Et je rétablirai tes juges comme au commencement, \q et tes conseillers comme au début. \q Après cela on t’appellera Ville de la justice, Cité fidèle.
fr.B: Je te rendrai des juges comme ceux que tu avais au commencement, \q et des conseillers comme ceux d’autrefois. \q Alors on t’appellera Ville de la justice, Cité fidèle.
fr.R: Je te donnerai de nouveau de bons juges et de sages conseillers, comme ceux que tu avais il y a longtemps. \q Alors on t’appellera Ville de la justice, Cité fidèle.

sw.L: Nami nitawarudisha waamuzi wako kama mwanzoni, \q na washauri wako kama hapo kwanza. \q Baada ya hayo utaitwa Mji wa Haki, Mji Mwaminifu.
sw.B: Nitakurudishia waamuzi kama wale uliokuwa nao mwanzoni, \q na washauri kama wale wa hapo kwanza. \q Ndipo utakapoitwa Mji wa Haki, Mji Mwaminifu.
sw.R: Nitakupa tena waamuzi wema na washauri wenye hekima, kama wale uliokuwa nao zamani. \q Ndipo utakapoitwa Mji wa Haki, Mji Mwaminifu.

vi.L: Ta sẽ lập lại các thẩm phán của ngươi như lúc ban đầu, \q và các mưu sĩ của ngươi như thuở trước. \q Sau đó ngươi sẽ được gọi là Thành Công Chính, Thành Trung Tín.
vi.B: Ta sẽ ban lại cho ngươi những thẩm phán như thuở ban đầu, \q những mưu sĩ như lúc khởi đầu. \q Bấy giờ ngươi sẽ được gọi là Thành Công Chính, Thành Trung Tín.
vi.R: Ta sẽ lại ban cho ngươi những thẩm phán tốt và những mưu sĩ khôn ngoan, như những người ngươi đã có từ xưa. \q Bấy giờ ngươi sẽ được gọi là Thành Công Chính, Thành Trung Tín.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 너의 재판관들을 처음처럼, \q 너의 조언자들을 시작 때처럼 회복하겠다. \q 그 후에 너는 의의 성, 신실한 성읍이라 불릴 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 처음처럼 너에게 재판관들을 돌려주고, \q 시작 때처럼 조언자들을 돌려주겠다. \q 그러면 너는 의로운 성, 신실한 성읍이라고 불릴 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 오래전에 있던 것처럼 좋은 재판관들과 지혜로운 조언자들을 다시 너에게 주겠다. \q 그러면 너는 의로운 성, 신실한 성읍이라고 불릴 것이다.

pt.L: E restaurarei os teus juízes como no princípio, \q e os teus conselheiros como no começo. \q Depois disso serás chamada a Cidade da Retidão, a Cidade Fiel.
pt.B: Eu te darei de volta juízes como os que tinhas no princípio, \q e conselheiros como os do começo. \q Então serás chamada a Cidade da Retidão, a Cidade Fiel.
pt.R: Vou te dar de novo bons juízes e conselheiros sábios, como os que tinhas muito tempo atrás. \q Então serás chamada a Cidade da Retidão, a Cidade Fiel.

am.L: ፈራጆችሽንም እንደ መጀመሪያው፣ \q አማካሪዎችሽንም እንደ ቀድሞው እመልሳለሁ። \q ከዚህም በኋላ የጽድቅ ከተማ፣ ታማኝ ከተማ ተብለሽ ትጠሪያለሽ።
am.B: በመጀመሪያ እንደ ነበሩሽ ያሉ ፈራጆችን፣ \q ቀድሞ እንደ ነበሩሽ ያሉ አማካሪዎችን መልሼ እሰጥሻለሁ። \q ከዚያም የጽድቅ ከተማ፣ ታማኟ ከተማ ተብለሽ ትጠሪያለሽ።
am.R: ጥንት እንደ ነበሩሽ ያሉ መልካም ፈራጆችንና ጥበበኛ አማካሪዎችን እንደ ገና እሰጥሻለሁ። \q ከዚያም የጽድቅ ከተማ፣ ታማኟ ከተማ ተብለሽ ትጠሪያለሽ።

hi.L: और मैं तुम्हारे न्यायियों को पहले के समान फिर से ठहराऊँगा, \q और तुम्हारे सलाहकारों को आरंभ के समान। \q इसके बाद तुम धार्मिकता की नगरी, विश्वासयोग्य नगरी कहलाओगी।
hi.B: मैं तुम्हें फिर से वैसे न्यायी दूँगा जैसे तुम्हारे पास पहले थे, \q और वैसे सलाहकार जैसे आरंभ में थे। \q तब तुम धार्मिकता की नगरी, विश्वासयोग्य नगरी कहलाओगी।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हें फिर से अच्छे न्यायी और बुद्धिमान सलाहकार दूँगा, जैसे बहुत पहले तुम्हारे पास थे। \q तब तुम धार्मिकता की नगरी, विश्वासयोग्य नगरी कहलाओगी।

ru.L: И восстановлю твоих судей, как прежде, \q и твоих советников, как вначале. \q После этого будут называть тебя Городом Праведности, Верным Городом.
ru.B: Я верну тебе судей, как те, что были у тебя прежде, \q и советников, как в начале. \q Тогда тебя назовут Городом Праведности, Верным Городом.
ru.R: Я снова дам тебе хороших судей и мудрых советников, какие были у тебя давным-давно. \q Тогда тебя назовут Городом Праведности, Верным Городом.

ja.L: わたしはあなたの裁き人たちを初めのように、 \q あなたの助言者たちを最初のように戻す。 \q その後、あなたは正義の都、忠実な町と呼ばれる。
ja.B: わたしはあなたに、初めのころのような裁き人たちを、 \q 最初のころのような助言者たちを返す。 \q そのとき、あなたは正義の都、忠実な町と呼ばれる。
ja.R: わたしは、昔あなたにいたような、良い裁判をする人や知恵のある相談役を、再びあなたに与える。 \q そのとき、あなたは正義の都、忠実な町と呼ばれる。

decisions.choice: the Faithful Town: verse 21 reversed
decisions.reason: "Faithful town" is the phrase of verse 21, where the city had become a prostitute. The passage ends where it began, with the city faithful again.

decisions.choice: judges and counselors: the city's leaders
decisions.reason: Judges decided cases; counselors advised the king. "As at the first" looks back to the city's early days, when justice was done, perhaps the reign of David (2 Samuel 8:15).

decisions.choice: you will be called: you will truly be
decisions.reason: A new name declares what the city will be (compare 60:14; 62:4, 12).

source.text: צִיּ֖וֹן בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט תִּפָּדֶ֑ה וְשָׁבֶ֖יהָ בִּצְדָקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Zion with justice will be redeemed, and her returning ones with righteousness.

en.L: Zion will be redeemed with justice, \q and her returning ones with righteousness.
en.B: Justice will set Zion free, \q and righteousness will free those of her people who turn back.
en.R: Justice will rescue Zion. \q Righteousness will rescue the people there who turn back to God.

es.L: Sion será redimida con derecho, \q y los que en ella vuelvan, con justicia.
es.B: El derecho pondrá en libertad a Sion, \q y la justicia librará a los de su pueblo que se vuelvan.
es.R: La justicia rescatará a Sion. \q La rectitud rescatará a la gente de allí que se vuelva a Dios.

fr.L: Sion sera rachetée par le droit, \q et ceux des siens qui reviennent, par la justice.
fr.B: Le droit libérera Sion, \q et la justice libérera ceux de son peuple qui reviennent.
fr.R: La justice sauvera Sion. \q Le droit sauvera les habitants qui reviendront à Dieu.

sw.L: Sayuni atakombolewa kwa haki, \q na wale wanaorudi ndani yake kwa uadilifu.
sw.B: Haki itamkomboa Sayuni, \q na uadilifu utawaweka huru watu wake wanaorudi.
sw.R: Haki itaiokoa Sayuni. \q Uadilifu utawaokoa watu wa huko wanaomrudia Mungu.

vi.L: Si-ôn sẽ được cứu chuộc bằng công lý, \q và những người quay về của nó bằng sự công chính.
vi.B: Công lý sẽ giải phóng Si-ôn, \q và sự công chính sẽ giải phóng những người trong dân nó biết quay về.
vi.R: Công lý sẽ giải cứu Si-ôn. \q Điều công chính sẽ giải cứu những người ở đó biết quay về với Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 시온은 정의로 구속될 것이고, \q 그 돌아오는 자들은 의로 [구속될 것이다].
ko.B: 시온은 정의로 구원을 받고, \q 그 백성 가운데 돌아오는 사람들은 의로 구원을 받을 것이다.
ko.R: 정의가 시온을 구해 낼 것이다. \q 옳은 일이 그곳에서 하나님께 돌아오는 사람들을 구해 낼 것이다.

pt.L: Sião será resgatada com justiça, \q e os que nela voltarem, com retidão.
pt.B: A justiça libertará Sião, \q e a retidão libertará os do seu povo que se converterem.
pt.R: A justiça vai salvar Sião. \q A retidão vai salvar as pessoas de lá que voltarem para Deus.

am.L: ጽዮን በፍርድ ትቤዣለች፤ \q ከእርሷም የሚመለሱት በጽድቅ።
am.B: ፍትሕ ጽዮንን ነጻ ያወጣታል፤ \q ጽድቅም ከሕዝቧ ወደ እርሱ የሚመለሱትን ነጻ ያወጣቸዋል።
am.R: ፍትሕ ጽዮንን ያድናታል። \q ጽድቅ በዚያ ያሉትንና ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚመለሱትን ሰዎች ያድናቸዋል።

hi.L: सिय्योन न्याय के द्वारा छुड़ाई जाएगी, \q और उसके लौटनेवाले धार्मिकता के द्वारा।
hi.B: न्याय सिय्योन को छुड़ाएगा, \q और धार्मिकता उसके उन लोगों को छुड़ाएगी जो लौट आते हैं।
hi.R: न्याय सिय्योन को बचाएगा। \q धार्मिकता वहाँ के उन लोगों को बचाएगी जो परमेश्वर की ओर लौट आते हैं।

ru.L: Сион будет искуплен справедливостью, \q и его обратившиеся — праведностью.
ru.B: Справедливость освободит Сион, \q а праведность — тех его жителей, кто обратится.
ru.R: Справедливость спасёт Сион. \q Праведность спасёт тех его жителей, кто вернётся к Богу.

ja.L: シオンは公正によって贖い出され、 \q その立ち帰る者たちは正義によって[贖い出される]。
ja.B: 公正がシオンを解き放ち、 \q 正義が、その民のうち立ち帰る者たちを解き放つ。
ja.R: 公正がシオンを救い出す。 \q 正義が、神に立ち帰るシオンの人々を救い出す。

decisions.choice: redeemed: set free, ransomed
decisions.reason: The verb means to set free by paying a price, as a firstborn or a slave was ransomed (Exodus 13:13; Deuteronomy 7:8).

decisions.choice: with justice ... with righteousness: by the justice done in judgment and restored in the city
decisions.reason: Zion is freed by justice: God's judgment that removes the wicked (verses 24-25, 28) and the right judges he restores (verse 26). It is not said whose justice it is, and both may be meant.

decisions.choice: her returning ones: those who turn back to God
decisions.reason: The word means those who turn or return. In this passage it most likely means those who repent, set against those who forsake Yahweh (verse 28). It can also mean those who come back from exile.

decisions.choice: turn back to God
decisions.reason: Readable names the one they turn back to (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: "구속되다" (L); "구원을 받다" (B); "구해 내다" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's verb for *padah* and *ga'al* at Literal; Balanced and Readable say the plain result, being set free.

decisions.choice: redeemed (padah) "ትቤዣለች" (L), "ነጻ ያወጣታል" (B, R); those who return (shuv) "የሚመለሱት"
decisions.reason: The terms list gives shuv as "ተመለሰ" through the prophets, so turning back to God keeps the plain verb of returning at every level.

decisions.choice: padah "redeem, ransom": "贖い出す" (L), "解き放つ" (B), "救い出す" (R); kept apart from ga'al / go'el ("贖う", "贖い主" L, B; the kinsman-redeemer of Ruth and Job 19:25), which Isaiah uses from chapter 35 on. shuv "turn back" "立ち帰る" (L, B), "神に立ち帰る" (R).
decisions.reason: Isaiah has both Hebrew verbs; a reader should be able to tell the ransom word from the kinsman's "贖い主" (go'el), which carries the Ruth and Job image of the near relative who buys back.

source.text: וְשֶׁ֧בֶר פֹּשְׁעִ֛ים וְחַטָּאִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וְעֹזְבֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִכְלֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [a] breaking of rebels and sinners together, and those forsaking Yahweh will come to an end.

en.L: But [there will be] a breaking of rebels and sinners together, \q and those who forsake {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will come to an end.
en.B: Rebels and sinners alike will be crushed, \q and all who walk away from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be finished.
en.R: But all who rebel and sin will be destroyed. \q People who turn away from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be gone.

es.L: Pero [habrá] quebranto de rebeldes y pecadores a la vez, \q y los que abandonan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} serán consumidos.
es.B: Rebeldes y pecadores por igual serán aplastados, \q y todos los que se alejan {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llegarán a su fin.
es.R: Pero todos los que se rebelan y pecan serán destruidos. \q Los que se apartan {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} desaparecerán.

fr.L: Mais [ce sera] la ruine des rebelles et des pécheurs ensemble, \q et ceux qui abandonnent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prendront fin.
fr.B: Rebelles et pécheurs seront brisés ensemble, \q et tous ceux qui s’éloignent {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} seront anéantis.
fr.R: Mais tous ceux qui se révoltent et qui pèchent seront détruits. \q Ceux qui se détournent {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} disparaîtront.

sw.L: Lakini [kutakuwa na] kuvunjwa kwa waasi na wenye dhambi pamoja, \q nao wanaomwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wataangamia.
sw.B: Waasi na wenye dhambi watapondwa pamoja, \q na wote wanaomwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} watakwisha.
sw.R: Lakini wote wanaoasi na kutenda dhambi wataangamizwa. \q Watu wanaomwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} watatoweka.

vi.L: Nhưng [sẽ có] sự tan nát của kẻ phản loạn và kẻ có tội cùng nhau, \q và những kẻ lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bị tiêu diệt.
vi.B: Kẻ phản loạn và kẻ có tội đều sẽ bị nghiền nát, \q và hết thảy những ai lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ bị tiêu vong.
vi.R: Nhưng mọi kẻ phản loạn và phạm tội sẽ bị hủy diệt. \q Những ai quay lưng với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không còn nữa.

ko.L: 그러나 반역자들과 죄인들이 함께 무너지고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 버리는 자들은 끝장날 것이다.
ko.B: 반역자들과 죄인들은 모두 함께 부서지고, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 떠나는 자들은 멸망할 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 거역하고 죄짓는 사람들은 모두 망할 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 등을 돌리는 사람들은 사라질 것이다.

pt.L: Mas [haverá] quebra de rebeldes e pecadores juntamente, \q e os que abandonam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} serão consumidos.
pt.B: Rebeldes e pecadores serão esmagados juntos, \q e todos os que se afastam {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} terão fim.
pt.R: Mas todos os que se rebelam e pecam serão destruídos. \q As pessoas que se afastam {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} vão desaparecer.

am.L: ዓመፀኞችና ኃጢአተኞች ግን በአንድነት ይሰበራሉ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚተዉም ይጠፋሉ።
am.B: ዓመፀኞችና ኃጢአተኞች በአንድነት ይደቅቃሉ፤ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ትተው የሚሄዱ ሁሉ ያከትማሉ።
am.R: የሚያምፁና ኃጢአት የሚሠሩ ሁሉ ግን ይጠፋሉ። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚተዉ ሰዎች ጨርሶ አይገኙም።

hi.L: पर विद्रोहियों और पापियों का एक साथ विनाश [होगा], \q और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को त्यागनेवालों का अंत हो जाएगा।
hi.B: विद्रोही और पापी दोनों कुचल दिए जाएँगे, \q और जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से दूर चले जाते हैं, उनका अंत हो जाएगा।
hi.R: पर जो विद्रोह करते और पाप करते हैं, वे सब नष्ट हो जाएँगे। \q जो लोग {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} से मुँह मोड़ लेते हैं, वे मिट जाएँगे।

ru.L: А [будет] сокрушение мятежникам и грешникам вместе, \q и оставляющие {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} исчезнут.
ru.B: Мятежники и грешники будут сокрушены все вместе, \q и все, кто уходит от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, погибнут.
ru.R: Но все, кто бунтует и грешит, будут уничтожены. \q Люди, которые отворачиваются от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, исчезнут.

ja.L: しかし、背く者たちと罪人たちには共に破滅[が来る]。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を捨てる者たちは尽き果てる。
ja.B: 背く者も罪人も、共に打ち砕かれ、 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}から離れ去る者は皆、滅び去る。
ja.R: しかし、神に逆らい、罪を犯す者は皆、滅ぼされる。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に背を向ける人々は、いなくなる。

decisions.choice: a breaking: the verse begins with a noun
decisions.reason: The verse has no verb in its first half: "a breaking of rebels and sinners". It is a short, sharp announcement of their end.

decisions.choice: rebels ... those who forsake Yahweh: the people of verses 2 and 4
decisions.reason: The words echo the charge at the start of the chapter: "they have rebelled against me" (verse 2), "they have forsaken Yahweh" (verse 4). Zion will be redeemed (verse 27), but not those who will not turn.

source.text: כִּ֣י יֵבֹ֔שׁוּ מֵאֵילִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲמַדְתֶּ֑ם וְתַ֨חְפְּר֔וּ מֵהַגַּנּ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For they will be ashamed of [the] oaks which you desired, and you will blush for the gardens which you chose.

en.L: For they will be ashamed of the oaks which you desired, \q and you will be abashed for the gardens which you chose.
en.B: Yes, the oaks you set your heart on will bring you shame; \q the gardens you chose will make you blush.
en.R: You loved to worship false gods under big trees and in special gardens. \q But you will be ashamed of those trees and gardens.

es.L: Porque se avergonzarán de las encinas que {{plural_you:ustedes desearon|vosotros deseasteis}}, \q y {{plural_you:se sonrojarán|os sonrojaréis}} por los jardines que {{plural_you:escogieron|escogisteis}}.
es.B: Sí, las encinas que tanto {{plural_you:desearon|deseasteis}} {{plural_you:les|os}} traerán vergüenza; \q los jardines que {{plural_you:escogieron|escogisteis}} {{plural_you:los harán|os harán}} sonrojar.
es.R: A {{plural_you:ustedes les encantaba|vosotros os encantaba}} adorar a dioses falsos bajo los árboles grandes y en jardines especiales. \q Pero {{plural_you:se avergonzarán|os avergonzaréis}} de esos árboles y jardines.

fr.L: Car ils auront honte des chênes que vous avez désirés, \q et vous rougirez des jardins que vous avez choisis.
fr.B: Oui, les chênes que vous aimiez tant vous couvriront de honte ; \q les jardins que vous avez choisis vous feront rougir.
fr.R: Vous aimiez adorer de faux dieux sous de grands arbres et dans des jardins spéciaux. \q Mais vous aurez honte de ces arbres et de ces jardins.

sw.L: Kwa maana wataona aibu kwa ajili ya mialoni mliyoitamani, \q nanyi mtaona haya kwa ajili ya bustani mlizozichagua.
sw.B: Naam, mialoni mliyoitamani itawaletea aibu; \q bustani mlizozichagua zitawatahayarisha.
sw.R: Mlipenda kuabudu miungu ya uongo chini ya miti mikubwa na katika bustani maalum. \q Lakini mtaona aibu kwa ajili ya miti hiyo na bustani hizo.

vi.L: Vì chúng sẽ hổ thẹn vì những cây sồi các ngươi đã ưa thích, \q và các ngươi sẽ xấu hổ vì những khu vườn các ngươi đã chọn.
vi.B: Phải, những cây sồi các ngươi say mê sẽ làm các ngươi hổ thẹn; \q những khu vườn các ngươi đã chọn sẽ khiến các ngươi xấu hổ.
vi.R: Các ngươi thích thờ các thần giả dưới những cây lớn và trong những khu vườn đặc biệt. \q Nhưng các ngươi sẽ xấu hổ về những cây và vườn ấy.

ko.L: 그들이 너희가 탐내던 상수리나무들 때문에 부끄러움을 당하고, \q 너희가 택한 동산들 때문에 너희가 낯을 붉힐 것이다.
ko.B: 너희가 좋아하던 상수리나무들이 너희에게 수치가 되고, \q 너희가 고른 동산들 때문에 너희가 얼굴을 붉힐 것이다.
ko.R: 너희는 큰 나무 아래와 특별한 동산에서 거짓 신들을 섬기기를 좋아했다. \q 그러나 너희는 그 나무들과 동산들 때문에 부끄러움을 당할 것이다.

pt.L: Porque eles se envergonharão dos carvalhos que vocês desejaram, \q e vocês corarão por causa dos jardins que escolheram.
pt.B: Sim, os carvalhos que vocês tanto desejaram vão cobri-los de vergonha; \q os jardins que vocês escolheram vão fazê-los corar.
pt.R: Vocês gostavam de adorar deuses falsos debaixo de árvores grandes e em jardins especiais. \q Mas vocês vão ter vergonha dessas árvores e desses jardins.

am.L: በወደዳችኋቸው ዛፎች ያፍራሉና፤ \q በመረጣችኋቸውም አትክልቶች ትዋረዳላችሁ።
am.B: አዎን፣ ልባችሁን የጣላችሁባቸው ትልልቅ ዛፎች ያሳፍሯችኋል፤ \q የመረጣችኋቸውም አትክልቶች ፊታችሁን ያቀላሉ።
am.R: በትልልቅ ዛፎች ሥርና በተለዩ አትክልቶች ውስጥ የሐሰት አማልክትን ማምለክ ወደዳችሁ። \q ነገር ግን በእነዚያ ዛፎችና አትክልቶች ታፍራላችሁ።

hi.L: क्योंकि वे उन बलूत के वृक्षों के कारण लज्जित होंगे जिनकी तुमने लालसा की, \q और तुम उन बग़ीचों के कारण शर्मिंदा होगे जिन्हें तुमने चुना।
hi.B: हाँ, जिन बलूत के पेड़ों पर तुमने मन लगाया, वे तुम्हें लज्जित करेंगे; \q जिन बग़ीचों को तुमने चुना, वे तुम्हें शर्मिंदा करेंगे।
hi.R: तुम्हें बड़े पेड़ों के नीचे और ख़ास बग़ीचों में झूठे देवताओं की पूजा करना अच्छा लगता था। \q पर तुम उन पेड़ों और बग़ीचों के कारण लज्जित होगे।

ru.L: Потому что они будут постыжены дубами, которых вы желали, \q и вы покраснеете из-за садов, которые вы выбрали.
ru.B: Да, дубы, к которым вы так стремились, принесут вам стыд; \q сады, которые вы выбрали, заставят вас краснеть.
ru.R: Вы любили поклоняться ложным богам под большими деревьями и в особых садах. \q Но вам будет стыдно за эти деревья и сады.

ja.L: まことに、彼らは自分たちが慕ったテレビンの木のゆえに恥じ、 \q あなたがたは自分たちが選んだ園のゆえに赤面する。
ja.B: まことに、あなたがたが心を寄せたテレビンの木は、あなたがたに恥をもたらし、 \q あなたがたが選んだ園は、あなたがたを赤面させる。
ja.R: あなたたちは、大きな木の下や特別な園で、偽りの神々を拝むのが好きだった。 \q しかし、その木や園のことで、あなたたちは恥をかく。

decisions.choice: oaks and gardens: places where other gods were worshiped
decisions.reason: Great trees and planted groves were favorite places for the worship of other gods (Deuteronomy 12:2; Hosea 4:13; Isaiah 57:5; 65:3; 66:17). The people chose and loved them; they will be ashamed of them.

decisions.choice: they ... you: a change of person
alternatives: they will be ashamed ... you desired (different groups)
decisions.reason: The verse begins with "they" and goes on with "you", a change common in the prophets' poetry. Both refer to the same people.

decisions.choice: you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "you" throughout, as the verse goes on, since both refer to the same people (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps "they".

decisions.choice: worship false gods under big trees
decisions.reason: Readable explains what the oaks and gardens were for (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: oaks (ʾelim) "ዛፎች" (L), "ትልልቅ ዛፎች" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The sacred trees are large shade trees, whose species Amharic readers would not know by a Hebrew name; "ትልልቅ ዛፎች" keeps the picture. The change from "they" to "you" is kept at Literal, as the meaning decision describes.

decisions.choice: 'elim / 'elah: "テレビンの木" (L, B), "大きな木" (R), as 1 Chronicles 10:12; Literal keeps the Hebrew's shift from "they" to "you" (m2), Balanced and Readable say "あなたがた / あなたたち" as the English.
decisions.reason: The tree is a large terebinth or oak where other gods were worshipped (m1); the Chronicles form is kept for the same Hebrew family, and Readable uses the plain word.

source.text: כִּ֣י תִֽהְי֔וּ כְּאֵלָ֖ה נֹבֶ֣לֶת עָלֶ֑הָ וּֽכְגַנָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־מַ֖יִם אֵ֥ין לָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For you will be like an oak withering its leaf, and like a garden which water there is not for it.

en.L: For you will be like an oak whose leaf is withering, \q and like a garden that has no water.
en.B: You yourselves will be like an oak whose leaves are drying up, \q like a garden left without water.
en.R: You will become like a tree whose leaves dry up, \q or like a garden that gets no water.

es.L: Porque {{plural_you:serán|seréis}} como una encina cuya hoja se marchita, \q y como un jardín que no tiene agua.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes mismos serán|Vosotros mismos seréis}} como una encina cuyas hojas se secan, \q como un jardín que se ha quedado sin agua.
es.R: {{plural_you:Llegarán|Llegaréis}} a ser como un árbol al que se le secan las hojas, \q o como un jardín que no recibe agua.

fr.L: Car vous serez comme un chêne dont la feuille se flétrit, \q et comme un jardin qui n’a pas d’eau.
fr.B: Vous serez vous-mêmes comme un chêne dont les feuilles se dessèchent, \q comme un jardin laissé sans eau.
fr.R: Vous deviendrez comme un arbre dont les feuilles sèchent, \q ou comme un jardin qui ne reçoit pas d’eau.

sw.L: Kwa maana mtakuwa kama mwaloni ambao jani lake linanyauka, \q na kama bustani isiyo na maji.
sw.B: Ninyi wenyewe mtakuwa kama mwaloni ambao majani yake yanakauka, \q kama bustani iliyoachwa bila maji.
sw.R: Mtakuwa kama mti ambao majani yake yanakauka, \q au kama bustani isiyopata maji.

vi.L: Vì các ngươi sẽ như cây sồi có lá đang tàn héo, \q và như khu vườn không có nước.
vi.B: Chính các ngươi sẽ như cây sồi lá đang khô héo, \q như khu vườn bị bỏ khô không nước.
vi.R: Các ngươi sẽ giống như một cây lá khô héo, \q hay như một khu vườn không được tưới nước.

ko.L: 너희는 잎이 시드는 상수리나무같이 되고, \q 물이 없는 동산같이 될 것이다.
ko.B: 너희 자신이 잎이 말라 가는 상수리나무처럼 되고, \q 물이 끊긴 동산처럼 될 것이다.
ko.R: 너희는 잎이 말라 버린 나무처럼 될 것이다. \q 물을 얻지 못한 동산처럼 될 것이다.

pt.L: Porque vocês serão como um carvalho cuja folha murcha, \q e como um jardim que não tem água.
pt.B: Vocês mesmos serão como um carvalho de folhas secando, \q como um jardim deixado sem água.
pt.R: Vocês vão ficar como uma árvore cujas folhas secam, \q ou como um jardim que não recebe água.

am.L: ቅጠሉ እንደሚረግፍ ዛፍ፣ \q ውኃም እንደሌለው አትክልት ትሆናላችሁና።
am.B: እናንተ ራሳችሁ ቅጠሎቹ እንደሚደርቁ ዛፍ፣ \q ያለ ውኃ እንደ ቀረ አትክልት ትሆናላችሁ።
am.R: ቅጠሎቹ እንደ ደረቁ ዛፍ ትሆናላችሁ፤ \q ወይም ውኃ እንደማያገኝ አትክልት።

hi.L: क्योंकि तुम उस बलूत के समान हो जाओगे जिसके पत्ते मुरझा रहे हैं, \q और उस बग़ीचे के समान जिसमें पानी नहीं।
hi.B: तुम स्वयं उस बलूत के समान हो जाओगे जिसके पत्ते सूख रहे हैं, \q उस बग़ीचे के समान जो बिना पानी के छोड़ दिया गया है।
hi.R: तुम उस पेड़ जैसे हो जाओगे जिसके पत्ते सूख जाते हैं, \q या उस बग़ीचे जैसे जिसे पानी नहीं मिलता।

ru.L: Потому что вы будете как дуб, у которого вянет лист, \q и как сад, у которого нет воды.
ru.B: Вы сами станете как дуб, чьи листья засыхают, \q как сад, оставленный без воды.
ru.R: Вы станете как дерево, у которого высыхают листья, \q или как сад, который не поливают.

ja.L: まことに、あなたがたは葉のしおれるテレビンの木のようになり、 \q 水のない園のようになる。
ja.B: あなたがた自身が、葉の枯れかけたテレビンの木のようになり、 \q 水のない園のようになる。
ja.R: あなたたちは、葉が枯れていく木のようになる。 \q 水をもらえない園のようになる。

decisions.choice: like an oak, like a garden: they become like what they worshiped
decisions.reason: The oaks and gardens of verse 29 now picture the worshipers themselves, dry and dying. Those who trust Yahweh are instead like a well-watered tree or garden (Psalm 1:3; Jeremiah 17:8; Isaiah 58:11).

source.text: וְהָיָ֤ה הֶחָסֹן֙ לִנְעֹ֔רֶת וּפֹעֲל֖וֹ לְנִיצ֑וֹץ וּבָעֲר֧וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֛ם יַחְדָּ֖ו וְאֵ֥ין מְכַבֶּֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And will become the strong [one] tinder, and his work a spark, and they will burn the two of them together, and there is not [one who] quenches.

en.L: And the strong will become tinder, and his work a spark, \q and the two of them will burn together, with no one to quench [them].
en.B: Whoever is strong will become tinder, and what he has made will be the spark; \q the two will burn together, and there will be no one to put out the flames.
en.R: Powerful people will burn like dry straw. The things they have made will be the spark that starts the fire. \q Both will burn together, and no one will put out the fire.

es.L: Y el fuerte se volverá estopa, y su obra, chispa, \q y arderán los dos juntos, sin que haya quien [los] apague.
es.B: El que es fuerte se volverá estopa, y lo que hizo será la chispa; \q los dos arderán juntos, y no habrá nadie que apague las llamas.
es.R: La gente poderosa arderá como paja seca. Las cosas que han hecho serán la chispa que encienda el fuego. \q Las dos cosas arderán juntas, y nadie apagará el fuego.

fr.L: Et le fort deviendra de l’étoupe, et son œuvre une étincelle, \q et tous deux brûleront ensemble, sans personne pour éteindre.
fr.B: Celui qui est fort deviendra de l’étoupe, et ce qu’il a fait sera l’étincelle ; \q les deux brûleront ensemble, et personne n’éteindra les flammes.
fr.R: Les gens puissants brûleront comme de la paille sèche. Ce qu’ils ont fabriqué sera l’étincelle qui allume le feu. \q Tout brûlera ensemble, et personne n’éteindra le feu.

sw.L: Naye mwenye nguvu atakuwa utambi, na kazi yake cheche, \q nao wote wawili wataungua pamoja, wala hakuna wa kuzima.
sw.B: Aliye na nguvu atakuwa kama utambi, na kazi ya mikono yake itakuwa cheche; \q vyote viwili vitaungua pamoja, wala hapatakuwa na mtu wa kuuzima moto.
sw.R: Watu wenye nguvu wataungua kama majani makavu. Vitu walivyovitengeneza vitakuwa cheche inayowasha moto. \q Vyote vitaungua pamoja, wala hakuna atakayeuzima moto.

vi.L: Người mạnh sẽ thành bùi nhùi, và việc làm của nó thành tia lửa, \q và cả hai sẽ cùng nhau bốc cháy, không có ai dập tắt.
vi.B: Kẻ mạnh sẽ thành mồi lửa, và công việc của nó sẽ là tia lửa; \q cả hai sẽ cùng cháy, không ai dập tắt được.
vi.R: Những kẻ có quyền thế sẽ cháy như rơm khô. Những thứ chúng làm ra sẽ là tia lửa làm bùng lên đám cháy. \q Cả hai sẽ cùng cháy, và không ai dập tắt được.

ko.L: 그리고 강한 자는 삼 부스러기가 되고, 그의 행위는 불티가 되어, \q 그 둘이 함께 탈 것이나, 끌 자가 없을 것이다.
ko.B: 힘센 자는 마른 삼 부스러기가 되고 그가 만든 것은 불티가 되어, \q 둘이 함께 타오르겠지만, 그 불을 끌 사람이 없을 것이다.
ko.R: 힘 있는 사람들은 마른 짚처럼 탈 것이다. 그들이 만든 것은 불을 붙이는 불씨가 될 것이다. \q 둘이 함께 타오르고, 아무도 그 불을 끄지 못할 것이다.

pt.L: E o forte se tornará estopa, e a sua obra, faísca, \q e os dois arderão juntos, sem [ninguém] que [os] apague.
pt.B: Quem é forte virará estopa, e o que ele fez será a faísca; \q os dois queimarão juntos, e não haverá quem apague o fogo.
pt.R: As pessoas poderosas vão queimar como palha seca. As coisas que elas fizeram serão a faísca que começa o fogo. \q As duas coisas vão queimar juntas, e ninguém vai apagar o fogo.

am.L: ብርቱውም እንደ ገለባ፣ ሥራውም እንደ ፍንጣሪ ይሆናል፤ \q ሁለቱም በአንድነት ይቃጠላሉ፤ የሚያጠፋቸውም የለም።
am.B: ብርቱ የሆነ ሁሉ ገለባ ይሆናል፤ የሠራውም ነገር ፍንጣሪ ይሆናል፤ \q ሁለቱ በአንድነት ይቃጠላሉ፤ እሳቱን የሚያጠፋም አይገኝም።
am.R: ኃያላን ሰዎች እንደ ደረቅ ገለባ ይቃጠላሉ። የሠሯቸው ነገሮች እሳቱን የሚያስነሣ ፍንጣሪ ይሆናሉ። \q ሁለቱም በአንድነት ይቃጠላሉ፤ እሳቱንም የሚያጠፋ ማንም አይኖርም።

hi.L: और बलवान सन का रेशा बन जाएगा, और उसका काम चिंगारी, \q और वे दोनों एक साथ जलेंगे, और [उन्हें] बुझानेवाला कोई न होगा।
hi.B: जो बलवान है, वह सूखे रेशे के समान होगा, और जो उसने बनाया है, वह चिंगारी; \q दोनों एक साथ जलेंगे, और लपटों को बुझानेवाला कोई न होगा।
hi.R: शक्तिशाली लोग सूखे भूसे की तरह जल जाएँगे। जो चीज़ें उन्होंने बनाई हैं, वे उस आग को सुलगानेवाली चिंगारी होंगी। \q दोनों एक साथ जलेंगे, और कोई आग को नहीं बुझाएगा।

ru.L: И станет сильный паклей, и его дело — искрой, \q и сгорят оба вместе, и никто не погасит [их].
ru.B: Сильный станет паклей, а то, что он сделал, — искрой; \q оба сгорят вместе, и некому будет потушить пламя.
ru.R: Сильные люди сгорят, как сухая солома. То, что они сделали, станет искрой, от которой начнётся пожар. \q Всё сгорит вместе, и никто не потушит огонь.

ja.L: そして、強い者は麻くずとなり、その業は火花となる。 \q その両者は共に燃え、[それを]消す者はいない。
ja.B: 強い者は麻くずのようになり、その者が造ったものが火花となる。 \q 両者は共に燃え上がり、その火を消す者はいない。
ja.R: 力のある人たちは、乾いたわらのように燃える。彼らが造ったものが、火をつける火花になる。 \q 両方とも一緒に燃え、だれも火を消さない。

decisions.choice: the strong: the powerful man
decisions.reason: The word means strong or mighty. It is used of oaks in Amos 2:9, so it may continue the picture of the great tree (verse 30), here standing for the powerful people of Judah.

decisions.choice: his work: what he has made, perhaps his idols
decisions.reason: The noun means work or deed. After verse 29 it may mean the idols and holy places the powerful have made; it may mean all their deeds. The man and his work become fuel and fire for each other.

decisions.choice: tinder: the fibers of flax, which catch fire at once
decisions.reason: The word means the loose fibers shaken from flax (Judges 16:9). They burn up in an instant.

decisions.choice: dry straw
decisions.reason: Readable compares the tinder to dry straw, something every reader knows burns quickly.
